description:
Why PlayStation?

PlayStation isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Today, we’re recognized as a global leader in entertainment producing The PlayStation family of products and services including PlayStation5, PlayStation4, PlayStationVR, PlayStationPlus, acclaimed PlayStation software titles from PlayStation Studios, and more.

PlayStation also strives to create an inclusive environment that empowers employees and embraces diversity. We welcome and encourage everyone who has a passion and curiosity for innovation, technology, and play to explore our open positions and join our growing global team.

The PlayStation brand falls under Sony Interactive Entertainment, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation.

Manager, Commercial Planning

S ao Paulo, Brazil (Hybrid)

The Manager, Commercial Planning will support demand forecasting across all PlayStation Categories (Hardware, Software and Peripherals) for the Latin America Region. In this role, you will collaborate with cross functional teams across Global, Americas, and local Latin American markets to contribute to a robust, consensus based demand plan. This position plays an important role in aligning demand with supply, improving forecast accuracy, supporting new product introductions, and driving S&OP processes to ensure operational efficiency and customer satisfaction.

You will have an opportunity to apply your business acumen, analytical mindset and organizational skills to help scale a growing regional business.

Reporting to the Head of Sales, PlayStation LATAM, this role supports key planning activities and offers visibility into strategic decision-making.

What You’ll Do:

  1. Lead and coach a regional commercial planning team, fostering collaboration, development, and performance excellence.
  2. Contribute to the development and execution of short- and long-term demand forecasts at product, category, and channel levels, using historical data, market trends, and promotional inputs.
  3. Support the S&OP process by working closely with Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Supply Chain teams to ensure alignment and accuracy.
  4. Act as a key liaison between regional sales teams, marketing, and operations to maintain coordinated and well-informed demand plans.
  5. Assist in building the yearly budget, quarterly forecast and monthly flash sales plans and follow its performance, reporting and explain variances.
  6. Support executive-level reporting and presentations with accurate and insightful forecasting data.
  7. Engage with channel teams to collaborate on forecasting and obtain and ensure that current and accurate information is used for demand forecasts.
  8. Monitor assumptions, risks, and opportunities impacting the demand plan, and communicate implications as needed.
  9. Review historical sales trends, research demand drivers, prepare forecast data, develop statistical forecast models, and evaluate results.
  10. Coordinate with Global and Americas planning teams to communicate market requirements and updates.
  11. Support Sales, MKT and Head of Sales on ad-hoc analysis to run the business. Manage day to day sales and planning operation.
  12. Improve data quality by ongoing validation & follow up of sell-out and sell-through.
  13. Understand new product introduction roadmaps to manage product transitions.

What We’re Looking For:

  1. 8+ years of relevant experience in Demand Planning, Supply Chain, Operations or Sales Planning.
  2. Bachelor’s degree in Business, Analytics, Engineering or related field.
  3. Past experience directly managing and developing a team while delivering strong business outcomes.
  4. Solid understanding of forecasting processes, S&OP, and commercial planning.
  5. Familiarity with planning tools such as SAP/IBP.
  6. Highly analytical, data-driven decision maker with strong organizational and prioritization skills.
  7. Ability to interpret complex data sets (both qualitative and quantitative) and present findings clearly and effectively.
  8. Collaborative team player with excellent communication skills and a solution-oriented mindset.
  9. Enthusiastic and confident team player with excellent verbal and written communication skills; able to connect and collaborate effectively across diverse teams. Brings an innovative mindset and learns quickly in dynamic environments.
  10. Clear and concise written skills. Ability to concept, write and develop persuasive, organized presentations.
  11. High level of organization and flexibility to deal with urgent requests.
  12. Proficient in Excel and PowerPoint.
  13. Bilingual in English is a must (Spanish is a plus).

Escopo: Desenvolver soluções de dados de variadas complexidades utilizando a plataforma Denodo para a modelagem, virtualização, otimização e integração de dados trabalhando com diversas fontes de dados.

Responsabilidades:

  1. Modelagem e Virtualização de Dados: Criar camadas de abstração para integrar dados de múltiplas fontes (bancos de dados, APIs, arquivos, data lakes, etc.). Definir modelos de dados virtuais otimizados para consumo por aplicações e usuários. Criar views lógicas para organizar e transformar os dados conforme as necessidades do negócio.
  2. Desenvolvimento e Otimização de Consultas: Escrever queries otimizadas em Denodo VQL (Virtual Query Language). Melhorar a performance de consultas através de técnicas como caching, indexação e partitioning. Configurar e testar diferentes métodos de delegação de queries para fontes de dados externas.
  3. Integração e Conectividade: Conectar o Denodo a diversas fontes, como bancos de dados relacionais (SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL), APIs REST/SOAP, arquivos CSV/JSON/XML, data lakes e sistemas legados. Configurar drivers JDBC, ODBC e Web Services para permitir que outras aplicações consumam dados virtualizados. Desenvolver integrações com ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Tableau, Qlik, Looker) e ETL.
  4. Segurança e Governança de Dados: Implementar controles de acesso baseados em perfis de usuários e regras de negócio. Gerenciar permissões e autenticação (LDAP, OAuth, SAML, Active Directory). Assegurar conformidade com regulamentações de proteção de dados (LGPD, GDPR).
  5. Monitoramento e Manutenção: Acompanhar o desempenho e a estabilidade dos serviços Denodo. Identificar e resolver problemas de conectividade, latência e erros em queries. Implementar boas práticas de log e auditoria para rastreabilidade dos acessos aos dados.

Requisitos:

  • Experiência em virtualização e integração de dados utilizando a Plataforma Denodo (VQL)
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em Banco de dados relacionais e não relacionais
  • Experiência avançada em SQL para queries complexas, otimização e indexação
  • Familiaridade com APIs REST/SOAP e WebServices

Working at WPP means being part of a global network of over 100,000 talented people dedicated to extraordinary work for our clients. WPP is a leader in marketing services, with strong AI, data, and technology capabilities, a global presence, and unmatched creative talent. Our clients include many Fortune Global 500 companies. We are committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging, and continuous learning, attracting top talent, and offering exciting career growth opportunities.

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. We’ve adopted a hybrid work model, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you need accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

About the role

Hogarth is seeking a highly skilled and innovative AI Engineer to join our post-production team. The ideal candidate will possess exceptional expertise in Gen AI tools, especially COMFY UI , with a strong background in prompting and generating images and videos using AI, visual effects (VFX), 3D CGI, and technical Python programming. This role requires a creative thinker capable of conceptualizing and executing cinematographic images, developing special effects, cleaning up shots, replacing products, and contributing to audiovisual editing and direction. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to push the boundaries of creativity and technology in advertising and storytelling.

Key Responsibilities

  1. AI Image and Video Generation
  • Leverage advanced AI tools like COMFY UI to generate high-quality images and videos for advertising projects.
  • Integrate generative AI workflows into the creative pipeline to enhance production efficiency and quality.
  • Visual Effects and CGI
    • Design and implement cutting-edge VFX and CGI solutions for commercial content.
    • Perform shot cleanup, object removal, product replacement, and scene enhancements.
    • Utilize tracking software (e.g., Mocha, Geo Tracker, PF Track) for precise compositing and alignment.
  • Audiovisual Editing and Direction
    • Collaborate on narrative direction and storytelling for audiovisual projects.
    • Edit video and audio content using industry-standard tools such as Adobe Premiere, After Effects, LTX, and Runway.
    • Create animatics and pre-visualizations to support project development.
  • Programming and Technical Expertise
    • Develop and optimize custom AI models and workflows tailored to specific project needs.
    • Write and maintain Python scripts to automate tasks, machine learning, and improve production pipelines.
    • Troubleshoot technical challenges and ensure seamless integration of AI tools into existing systems.
    • Partner with creative teams to brainstorm and conceptualize visually compelling advertising campaigns.
    • Use AI and 3D tools (e.g., Blender, Unreal Engine, 3D Studio) to create virtual production environments and assets.
  • Collaboration and Innovation
    • Stay updated on emerging technologies and trends in AI, VFX, and post-production.
    • Provide training and mentorship to team members on AI tools and techniques.
    • Work closely with clients and stakeholders to understand project goals and deliver outstanding results.

Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.

The Project Buyer is responsible for ensuring the procurement of goods and services for specific projects, including international sourcing and import activities. This role involves sourcing, negotiating, selecting and managing supplier relationships to ensure the timely and cost-effective delivery of high-quality materials and services. This role involves coordinating import activities, managing documentation, and ensuring compliance with international trade regulations.

This position reports to the Procurement & Strategic Sourcing Manager Latam and is part of the Supply Chain team located in Diadema-SP and will be an on-site role.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

  • Project Coordination: Collaborate with project managers and other stakeholders to ensure procurement activities align with project timelines and objectives.

  • Supplier Analysis: Identify and evaluate potential suppliers, negotiate contracts, build relationships with suppliers to ensure project requirements are met to secure the best pricing and terms.

  • Contract Management: Ensure compliance with contractual terms and conditions, and negotiate changes as needed to align with project needs.

  • Cost Reduction: Drive cost reduction initiatives and process improvement projects to enhance efficiency and reduce expenses.

  • Process Improvement: Identify and implement strategies to streamline import processes and reduce costs.

The essential requirements of the job include:

  • Bachelor’s degree in: Business, Supply Chain, International Relations, or a related field.

  • 5+ years of experience in import operations in procurement or a related role, working in all aspects of import activities, customs clearance, documentation, and compliance with international trade regulations.

  • Fluent in English, with excellent communication and negotiation skills.

  • Track record of analysing supplier data to identify cost-saving opportunities and process improvements, while handling issues like delays and discrepancies.

  • Experience inproviding reports on project status, supplier performance and purchasing activities, including cost analyses and inventory status.

It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:

  • Analytical and problem-solving skills.

System Software Engineer - Ubuntu Networking

Join to apply for the System Software Engineer - Ubuntu Networking role at Canonical

System Software Engineer - Ubuntu Networking

5 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the System Software Engineer - Ubuntu Networking role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring a System Software Engineer for Ubuntu Networking
Our growing investment in Ubuntu now enables us to hire a group of outstanding systems software engineers to focus on the connectivity of Ubuntu in a wide range of circumstances, from cloud to server to desktop and IoT. We would like to strengthen the tooling, services, documentation, robustness, security and clarity of Linux network abstractions to provide fast, reliable and secure connections for Ubuntu.
The network stack is one of the most critical aspects of any operating system where stability, reliability and uptime are paramount. Its ease of use and reliability contribute to Ubuntu's success from IoT, Desktop, Server to the Cloud. We are expanding our Foundations team to focus our efforts on this essential function and are looking for people passionate about lower level technologies involved in an operating system's network stack. Applicants will be comfortable discussing bridges, bonds, routing, DNS resolution and other technologies used to interconnect modern operating systems. We'll work with a very wide range of upstream components and communities covering a wide range of connectivity tech. We might touch the kernel, iwd, networkmanager, wpa_supplicant, bluetooth stacks, conman, mobile data stacks, ethernet, infiniband, network virtualisation capabilities, VPNs and offload to smartnics. We model Ubuntu connectivity with Netplan and will continue to drive this forward as the easiest and most effective central tool to enable connectivity everywhere.
The Ubuntu Foundations Team delivers and maintains the core of the Ubuntu system, the base for the entire Ubuntu family of products and services. Ubuntu strives to deliver the latest and best free software components, in an easy to use and highly reliable form. We build on the technical excellence of Debian and bring additional focus and shape to the solutions we offer industry.
As a Linux System Engineer, you will maintain and integrate core components involved in the network stack of the Ubuntu Distribution. You will be discussing design with other team members, upstream projects, mentor less senior engineers and participate in code reviews and design reviews. You will also be working with other teams to ensure architecture decisions improve the overall performance and experience of Ubuntu.

Location: This role will be based remotely in the AMERICAS region
The role entails

  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team
  • Shape software-define networking products for evolving data center architectures to meet ever-increasing bandwidth, reliability, security, and interoperability demands
  • Write high-quality, well-designed and well-documented software
  • Debug issues and produce high-quality code to fix them
  • Collaborate proactively with a globally distributed organization
  • Contribute to technical documentation to make it the best of its kind
  • Display technical leadership internally, towards our partners, and in the open source communities
  • Influence open-source projects and communities
  • Shape innovative product strategies
  • Work from home with global travel 2 to 4 weeks a year for internal and external events
What we are looking for in you
  • Deep understanding and passion for Linux networking, from kernel to user space
  • Professional experience with computer networks, including virtual networks, distributed systems as well as understanding of hardware offloading technologies.
  • Interest in systemd-networkd, NetworkManager, ModemManager, iwd, conman, bluez, iproute2, Open vSwitch, WireGuard and similar software components
  • Fluency in at least one of Golang, C/C++, Rust or Python
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Interest in packaging software for Debian and Ubuntu
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path
  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You are passionate, curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable
  • You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self-motivated
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person

  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
This is a general selection track for teams that focus on back-end REST API microservices engineering in Go and Python. It covers all levels of seniority. Apply here if you are already an outstanding engineer with crisp and well-articulated views on APIs, microservice design, engineering processes and DevOps.
Our services need to scale to handle millions of Ubuntu clients, and collaboration across thousands of community members. They are also central to the health of critical infrastructure across the globe. As Ubuntu has been embraced by mainstream enterprise computing through the adoption of cloud and developer-centric tech strategy, the quality of these services has become more important to customers and users.
While Ubuntu has been enormously successful and in many senses leads the industry, we think we can substantially improve our practices, quality and performance in the web services domain. We are growing our teams, and in doing so we aim to level up our insights on scalability, performance, resilience and DevOps practices.

  • API design, documentation, and governance

  • Professional written and spoken English
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Passion, thoughtfulness, and self-motivation
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills

Additional Skills That You Might Also Bring

What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA

MISSÃO DO CARGO

Sobre a Vaga:

Na Laços Saúde, acreditamos que o cuidado deve ser um reflexo da individualidade de cada pessoa, promovendo a autonomia e a qualidade de vida dos nossos pacientes. Como parte do nosso compromisso com um modelo inovador de assistência, buscamos Médicos Geriatras apaixonados pela transformação do cuidado à saúde no ambiente domiciliar, seguindo os princípios do modelo Buurtzorg, que prioriza o autocuidado e a manutenção das funcionalidades das pessoas em suas próprias comunidades.

Diagnóstico que Buscamos:

  • Formação em Medicina com Residência em Geriatria, Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM).
  • Experiência prévia em atenção domiciliar ou saúde comunitária será um diferencial.
  • Paixão por promover o autocuidado e a autonomia dos pacientes, com uma abordagem centrada na pessoa.
  • Habilidade em comunicação e empatia, fundamentais para o estabelecimento de vínculos com pacientes e familiares.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma colaborativa e multidisciplinar, integrando ações que promovam a saúde do paciente no seu ambiente familiar.
  • Proatividade na busca de soluções que promovam a qualidade de vida e a funcionalidade dos pacientes.

Sobre Nós:

Na Laços Saúde, a diversidade é o coração do nosso trabalho. Acreditamos que cuidar é um ato de amor e acolhimento, e isso se reflete em nossa equipe, que é composta por profissionais de diversas origens e experiências. O modelo Buurtzorg que adotamos é mais do que um método: é uma filosofia que prioriza o cuidado comunitário, respeitando a individualidade e as necessidades de cada pessoa. Se você é um fisioterapeuta que acredita na transformação do cuidado à saúde, venha fazer parte da nossa equipe e ajude a moldar o futuro da saúde no Brasil. Aqui, cada dia é uma nova oportunidade de fazer a diferença na vida das pessoas.

Tem Paixão pelo Cuidado? Então junte-se a nós!

A Laços Saúde está pronta para receber você!

Vamos juntos cuidar da saúde da comunidade!

Proporcionar atendimento psiquiátrico de qualidade, acessível e humanizado através da telemedicina, promovendo o bem-estar mental e emocional dos pacientes. O médico geriatra deve atuar com empatia, responsabilidade e ética, garantindo diagnósticos e tratamentos assertivos, respeitando a individualidade de cada paciente e contribuindo para a melhoria de sua qualidade de vida. Fortalecer a confiança no atendimento remoto, assegurando que cada consulta seja conduzida com o mesmo rigor e acolhimento de um atendimento presencial.

RESPONSABILIDADES:

  • Atuar em consonância com os valores da organização, mantendo conduta focada em resultados do Cuidado, respeitando a individualidade de cada paciente, tornando a assistência personalizada.
  • Registrar no Prontuário do Paciente as informações inerentes e indispensáveis ao processo de cuidar, mantendo-os atualizados.
  • Ser representante da organização, zelando por suas premissas, prestando cuidado baseado em evidências científicas e melhores práticas.
  • Realizar o Cuidado Integral ao Paciente, cuidando com Empatia e Carinho, estabelecendo vínculos e considerando as suas necessidades biopsicossociais.
  • Garantir a continuidade da Assistência Médica por meio da execução do Plano de Cuidado estabelecido.
  • Distribuir adequadamente a agenda de consultas, cumprindo a carga horária e número de atendimentos, conforme o contrato estabelecido.

Nossa história começou em 2001, com um pequeno escritório de agentes autônomos de investimentos em Porto Alegre e hoje somos um grande ecossistema de serviços financeiros, mídia e educação.

Chegamos até aqui com a dedicação de equipes talentosas que tiveram garra, determinação, resiliência e, acima de tudo, ambição de fazer o impossível.

  • Foco no cliente: Somos obstinados em superar as expectativas dos nossos clientes.
  • Sonho grande: Miramos no impossível, acreditamos que ele pode se tornar realidade, e chegamos lá juntos.
  • Mente aberta: Nossa abertura para o novo e nossa capacidade de adaptação são o que nos fazem evoluir e melhorar sempre.
  • Espírito empreendedor: Construímos o futuro com nossas próprias mãos com o mais alto nível de comprometimento e sentimento de dono.

Sobre a Oportunidade

Essa oportunidade é para a Mesa de Operações Institucional Offshore, que tem a missão de garantir eficiência e segurança na execução das operações internacionais, aliando excelência operacional com inovação e melhoria contínua dos processos da mesa.
A área em questão é responsável pela negociação de swaps de juros e derivativos de moedas OTC offshore para clientes Institucionais, atuando em um ambiente de alta velocidade e precisão.
Esse é um time apaixonado por resolver desafios diários com inteligência e agilidade, suportando diretamente as demandas da mesa e garantindo que as operações sejam fluídas do pré ao pós-trade.
Você pode se dar muito bem se gostar de atuar em um ambiente dinâmico, propor soluções criativas e desenvolver ferramentas que facilitem o dia a dia da equipe.

Requisitos

  • Perfil analítico, organizado e com boa comunicação interpessoal.
  • Interesse genuíno pelo mercado financeiro e pelo funcionamento do mercado offshore.
  • Proatividade para buscar melhorias e colaborar com diferentes áreas da empresa.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência prévia em ambientes de mesa de operação ou suporte ao negócio no mercado financeiro.
  • Desenvolver scripts ou automações para facilitar rotinas de trabalho.
  • Inglês avançado para comunicação com público internacional.
  • Curiosidade constante por novas tecnologias e soluções para otimização de processos.

Desafios e Impacto

  • Desenvolver soluções escaláveis para automação de rotinas operacionais e controle de operações internacionais OTC (swaps de juros e derivativos de moedas).
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares em projetos de inovação e melhoria contínua nos fluxos pré e pós trade da mesa institucional offshore.
  • Otimizar a eficiência e a segurança na execução de operações em ambientes de alta velocidade e precisão.
  • Implementar ferramentas e scripts que reduzam riscos operacionais e aumentem a fluidez das operações para clientes institucionais.

Processo Seletivo

  • Triagem inicial: Análise do currículo para verificar a adequação às qualificações e requisitos da vaga.
  • Testes gerais: Avaliação do alinhamento cultural com o teste da Mindsight e teste de raciocínio lógico da Predictive Index.
  • Vídeo entrevista: Uma oportunidade para nos conhecermos melhor e entender suas motivações e experiências.
  • Entrevista com a equipe de Recrutamento: Discussão sobre as expectativas em relação à vaga e aos objetivos profissionais.
  • Avaliação técnica: Entrevista/dinâmica/teste focado nas habilidades específicas necessárias para a função.
  • Entrevista com a liderança: Uma conversa para discutir sua visão e como você pode contribuir para a equipe e a empresa.
  • Entrevista com colegas de trabalho: Interação com futuros pares para avaliar a sinergia e o trabalho em equipe.
  • Entrevista focada em cultura: Exploração dos valores e princípios da empresa para garantir um bom encaixe cultural.
  • Oferta: Apresentação da proposta de trabalho, incluindo detalhes sobre remuneração e benefícios.

Benefícios

  • Saúde e bem-estar: plano de saúde, plano odontológico, Gympass, Zenklub, VA, VR, New Value, seguro de vida.
  • Maternidade e Paternidade: auxílio creche para pais e mães, licença maternidade de 6 meses, licença paternidade de 20 dias.
  • Só na XP Inc.: assessoria de investimento e acesso a fundos de investimentos exclusivos.

Jornada de trabalho com flexibilidade

O nosso modelo de trabalho varia de acordo com a função: presencial para frentes de negócio e híbrido para as demais equipes. É importante ressaltar que todos os colaboradores precisam morar na localidade da vaga (nossa sede está localizada na cidade de São Paulo e é onde temos o maior número de posições), já que temos atividades que exigem a presença física para promover a colaboração e os rituais da nossa cultura. Esses encontros são organizados de acordo com as orientações dos líderes e as particularidades de cada rotina, para que nossos colaboradores possam exercer suas jornadas de trabalho com liberdade e autonomia.

title: Graduate Legal Counsel - Tech Sector
description:
Join to apply for the Graduate Legal Counsel - Tech Sector role at Canonical

Join to apply for the Graduate Legal Counsel - Tech Sector role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are expanding our in-house legal team, creating an opportunity for an exceptional recent graduate as junior Legal Advisor or junior Legal Counsel. The successful candidate will be a rigorous and effective practitioner with a track record of academic achievement and social engagement. At Canonical they will have the opportunity to work on a variety of transactional matters in the technology and enterprise software realm, as well as the contracts that underpin global employment, contracting and partnerships. In this appointment we are more focused on ability than experience; the position is open to applicants with a relevant degree, but does not have a requirement for extensive work experience. The successful candidate will work closely with our in-house legal team and colleagues worldwide.
Candidates must be able to demonstrate good commercial judgment as well as being organized, efficient, and capable to provide high quality legal and commercial advice. We are looking for a rigorous work ethic, detailed analysis, conscientiousness, and the ambition to identify opportunities for improvement.
Location : This role is home based in Europe, the Middle East, Africa or the Americas, with the option of our London office.
The role entails

  • Report to our global general counsel
  • Draft, review, and negotiate commercial contracts with customers and vendors in many countries across the globe
  • Provide legal support to various internal clients across the company, including Canonical's sales organization
  • Interface with cross-functional teams to support company initiatives
  • Utilize Canonical's contract management system to ensure accurate data is maintained for signed contracts
  • Work with local counsel in many countries to seek and implement advice
What we are looking for in you
  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • A degree in law, JD or equivalent, and active license to practice law or current progress towards that
  • Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • Strong organizational and prioritization skills with the ability to work in a fast-paced, multi-cultural environment
  • Effective both independently and as part of a team
  • A passion for technology evidenced by personal initiatives and projects
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent drafting and presentation skills
  • Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation
  • Appreciative of diversity; polite and effective in a multicultural multinational organization
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Thoughtfulness and self-motivation
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long
Nice-to-have skills
  • Experience in commercial transactions, intellectual property, or corporate law
  • Leadership and the ability to influence others to embrace new ideas or practices
  • Understanding of the open source software community and values
  • Understanding of the technology industry - silicon, data centers, PCs, connected devices, and software
  • Experience working on in-house legal team and/or law firm
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

A mineradora é a indústria mais longeva do país, com 190 anos de atuação, e uma das maiores produtoras de ouro do Brasil. Com cerca de 3 mil empregados diretos, as operações brasileiras estão entre as mais avançadas do mundo no campo da tecnologia de mineração, pela excelência dos equipamentos e processos utilizados e pelo desenvolvimento de soluções de engenharia foco em segurança e na prática de uma mineração responsável no subsolo.

Na AngloGold Ashanti, acreditamos que a diversidade é uma força transformadora. Estamos comprometidos em revolucionar o setor da mineração, promovendo um ambiente onde cada pessoa seja valorizada por sua singularidade, com a equidade e a inclusão como pilares fundamentais de nossa cultura.

Como parte desse compromisso, atuamos ativamente para ampliar a representatividade de gênero no setor e avançar na construção de um futuro mais justo e sustentável.

REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • Graduação concluída em Administração, Engenharia de Produção ou correlatas, Economia, Contabilidade e afins.
  • Pós-graduação concluída em Logística, Gestão de Projetos ou afins.
  • Vasta atuação em cargos de Gerência direcionada para gestão de almoxarifado.
  • Expertise em gerenciamento operacional e estratégico de almoxarifados industriais de grande porte.
  • Forte experiência em controle e gestão de estoques de materiais, peças, equipamentos.
  • Consolidada experiência na gestão de almoxarifados e logística.
  • Alto conhecimento e experiência nas melhores práticas de gerenciamento de estoque.
  • Compreensão dos Incoterms e do processo de importação.
  • Capacidade de análise financeira e gestão de custos/despesas.
  • Alta compreensão das atividades da indústria de mineração.
  • Experiência e conhecimento de SAP módulos WM e MRP.
  • Habilidades de gerenciamento de projetos.
  • Proficiente no uso de pacote Microsoft, incluindo Excel, Word e PowerPoint.
  • Proficiência em nível avançado no idioma Inglês - escrito e oral.

CONHECIMENTOS DESEJÁVEIS

  • Desejável conhecimento e experiência em práticas de sourcing e aquisição de material e serviços.
  • Diferencial experiência com MS Project.
  • Desejável conhecimento no módulo SAP Ariba.

RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Representar a área de Suprimentos nas operações, sendo ponto de conexão e interação entre Operações e de Suprimentos.
  • Liderar as operações de almoxarifado, incluindo gestão das operações de posto de combustível e paiol de explosivos, dos sites Cuiabá/Lamego e Queiroz.
  • Controle de estoque, armazenamento, logística e atividades de remessa com foco no controle de custos, além de melhorar a eficiência e a precisão no gerenciamento de estoque e da cadeia de suprimentos.
  • Responsável por comportamentos consistentes com a Missão, Visão e Valores da AngloGold Ashanti.
  • Promover uma cultura de Saúde e Segurança entre os colaboradores.
  • Contribuir para a Excelência Operacional, proporcionando melhorias de desempenho sustentáveis por meio de liderança, disciplina e processo.
  • Garantir a conformidade com as práticas legais e de compliance em sua área de responsabilidade.
  • Desenvolver e manter relações de trabalho eficazes com todos os stakeholders locais e regionais.
  • Monitorar se todas as políticas, procedimentos e orientações emitidas pela administração do site relevante são cumpridas.
  • Gerenciar as operações de almoxarifado e a cadeia envolvida.
  • Definir responsabilidades e tarefas críticas para todos os subordinados diretos.
  • Definir e implementar a estrutura organizacional aprovada necessária para entregar o orçamento e o plano de negócios do almoxarifado.
  • Envolver e desenvolver as pessoas adequadamente qualificadas, capazes e experientes.
  • Identificar as necessidades específicas de desenvolvimento de cada funcionário do departamento, oferecendo oportunidades de treinamento, coaching, projetos e atribuição de funções para que o indivíduo se desenvolva em todo o seu potencial.
  • Gerenciar os supervisores de almoxarifado no desempenho de suas funções, incluindo recebimento e saídas, reconciliação de estoque, carga e descarga, armazenamento e manuseio, estoques e MRP.
  • Auditar o inventário de estoque do almoxarifado para garantir que o processo de retirada de estoque seja concluído até o final do ano civil, de acordo com os requisitos financeiros e da SOX.
  • Gerenciar as atividades do almoxarifado para fornecer o nível de serviço otimizado para fornecer os recursos de que a empresa precisa para atingir suas metas.
  • Estabelecer e monitorar procedimentos de armazenamento e manuseio.
  • Responsável por identificar e recomendar oportunidades para otimizar a utilização de frete e logística para cada site.
  • Gerenciar e coordenar provedores logísticos terceirizados, incluindo agentes de agenciamento de cargas internacionais.
  • Responsável por desenvolver e gerenciar os orçamentos (Budget) de Capex, operação e pessoal relativos aos almoxarifados dos sites.
  • Identificar e desenvolver melhorias de processo para processos e sistemas de logística, estoque e armazém a partir de uma visão regional.
  • Implementar processos e sistemas globais de estoque e almoxarifado da AGA.
  • Suportar no gerenciamento e coordenação do processo de planejamento da produção, incluindo previsão de oferta/demanda, gerenciamento de estoque e entrega no prazo.
  • Implementar e executar as melhores práticas na gestão da área.

In this position, you will be responsible for defining the product roadmap, designing the product, and driving the rollout in collaboration with tech teams, product teams, and stakeholders from emerging countries. This is an individual contributor position that requires a strong sense of business and operations, product insights, and a willingness to dive deep. If you are excited by the challenge of designing end-to-end supply chain and fulfillment products for 10 countries, this may be the next big career move for you.
A successful candidate will demonstrate:
- Strong program and product management skills
- Ability to work with multiple stakeholders from various areas including operations and tech
- Ability to work with internal and external customers to identify opportunities and translate them into clear solutions and business requirements
- Ability to deliver on multiple deadlines and prioritize compulsively as a self-directed individual, comfortable with a fast-paced, ambiguous environment
- Ability to build strong relationships with stakeholders and key partners for the initiatives you’re owning/collaborating on
- Ability to communicate clearly and effectively with developers, business owners, and senior business leaders
Key job responsibilities
- Work with multiple operations and internal software development teams to design, build, and maintain processes and features to help drive supply chain and fulfillment products expansion in ROW
- Define, own, and manage the supply chain feature roadmap with the software development teams using Agile Software Development to deliver customer valued features
- Clarify and drive project priorities and commitments, as well as establish and maintain clear chains of project management and accountability
- Interact with Project Sponsors, Technical Product Managers, and multiple Development Teams to define and deliver complex features
- Collaborate with Global Technology and Product teams to understand global processes and refine them to suit the ROW business context and requirements
- Anticipate bottlenecks, provide escalation management, anticipate and make tradeoffs, and balance the business needs versus technical constraints
- Drive effective teamwork, communication, collaboration and commitment across multiple disparate groups with competing priorities
A day in the life
- Define the three-year product roadmap and the OP product roadmap.
- Design the product based on the vision and stakeholder requirements.
- Track and report the product development progress.
- Roll out the product to ROW countries and drive adoption
About the team
The ROW (Rest Of World, which includes India, Japan, AMET, BR, MX, SG and AU) SHARP team is driving several innovations and optimizations in Amazon's Supply Chain and Fulfillment Centers, to bring the world’s most customer centric experience to the ROW countries.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

- Bachelor's degree
- Experience in product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
- Experience working across functional teams and senior stakeholders
- Advanced English proficiency

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience in influencing senior leadership through data driven insights

Join to apply for the Software Engineering Manager - Sustaining Engineering role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1100+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We are hiring a Engineering Manager for Sustaining Engineering passionate about open source software, Linux and cloud computing. Come build a rewarding, meaningful career working with the best and brightest people in technology at Canonical, the growing international software company behind Ubuntu.
Sustaining Engineering is a business critical team that continuously improves various open source software by resolving software defects reported by customers. Software stack includes everything from the kernel all the way up to the user space applications and IaaS platforms. This position leads one of our regional teams and is one of several managers, who report directly to the global Director of Sustaining Engineering.
Our customers build large-scale mission critical infrastructure and application solutions on Ubuntu and open source from Canonical. While not actively developing products, Sustaining Engineering, as part of Support Engineering, solves problems for the customer and for the benefit of the wider Open Source community. This team is well staffed with experts in every time zone and, while the work can be challenging sometimes, the team is resourced to ensure a good work-life balance and ongoing development of each team member.
As an engineering manager in the Sustaining Engineering team, your primary responsibility is to the people you support: ensuring that they are growing as engineers, making valuable contributions, and generally having a great experience at Canonical. Technical leadership and a solid background in software development are a must, so that you are able to help your team members grow professionally. You will have the opportunity to influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.
Location: This is a globally remote role, unless specified otherwise.
The role entails

  • Manage and lead a distributed team of engineers
  • Hire, coach, mentor, provide feedback and career development guidance to your team
  • Manage & measure key performance indicators (KPIs), and training
  • Support timely delivery of bug fixes, patches, and other technical solutions to address business needs in a variety of technology fields, including but not limited to Ubuntu, OpenStack, Ceph, Kubernetes, Juju & MAAS
  • Demonstrate the very best of Canonical in customer interactions
  • Set and manage expectations with other engineering teams, senior management, and external stakeholders
  • Advocate and advance modern software development practices
  • Grow a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company value
  • Collaborate with other teams in the organisation
  • Work from home with global travel up to 10% for internal and external events
What we are looking for in you
  • Professional software delivery experience using C, C++, Go, Python, or similar
  • You are knowledgeable and passionate about software development
  • Leadership experience displaying ability to organise and prioritise complex problem resolution and bug fixes
  • Experience with version control systems such as git
  • Experience with debugging tools such as gdb, crash or other
  • Demonstrated strong commitment to testing methodologies and maintainable code quality
  • Excellent communication skills in the English language, both verbal and written
  • Experience with Linux, with a preference towards Ubuntu
  • Experience with Open Source and Open Source Business Models
  • People management experience in a support organisation is a strong plus
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. 1 week ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Software Platform Engineering Manager - Ubuntu for Next-Gen Silicon role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring engineering managers who are passionate about operational systems, open source technologies and cutting-edge hardware to lead engineering teams to enable and optimize Ubuntu for the latest x86, ARM, RISC-V, s390x and POWER systems.
We partner with the world's leading silicon vendors to optimise Ubuntu on their latest platforms. We integrate next-generation features and performance enhancements in Ubuntu while also ensuring a common operating experience for their users.
Engineering Managers should be outstanding developers themselves. They should be completely at home reviewing a patch or a software design spec. You will be expected to drive healthy engineering practices, documentation, quality and performance optimisations as well as lead your team to deliver high-quality design and code.
An Engineering Manager is responsible for line management and career guidance. The ability to develop engineering talent, to represent your team and product from a technical perspective, and to drive collaboration with other teams and customers are all critical to success in this role.
You will have the opportunity to influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.
Location: This is a globally remote role. We have open positions in every time zone.
What your day will look like

  • Lead and develop a team of engineers, ranging from graduate to senior
  • Oversee commercial engagements and support timely delivery on agreed project milestones
  • Participate as technical lead on complex customer engagements involving complete system architectures
  • Implement disciplined engineering processes
  • Integrate and maintain platform-oriented software stacks
  • Optimize Ubuntu for latest hardware platforms
  • Display technical leadership internally and within our external communities
  • Contribute to code reviews and technical documentation
  • Be an active part of the leadership team, collaborating with other leaders
What we are looking for in you
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • Fluency in C, C++, and Python
  • Experience with Linux and operational systems software (e.g. kernel or user space)
  • Experience with Debian/Ubuntu or other distro packaging
  • Experience leading software engineering teams
  • Professional written and spoken English
  • Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation
  • Thoughtfulness, and self-motivation
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long
Nice-to-have skills
  • Experience working with open source communities and licenses
  • Computer architecture knowledge of x86, ARM, RISC-V or s390x
  • Understanding of build systems and toolchains, including for cross-compilation
  • Experience working with customers
  • Experience with board bring up and validation
  • Experience with Linux virtualization, networking or graphics stacks
  • Experience with one or more of the follow
  • Experience with Docker/OCI containers/K8s
  • ing technologies: confidential computing, RDMA, Infiniband and high performance computing.
  • Performance engineering, benchmarking and profiling
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Job Description

Join the team redefining how the world experiences design.

Thanks for stopping by. We know job hunting can be time-consuming and you're probably eager to learn about the role, so we'll get straight to the point.

Where And How You Can Work

Our headquarters is in Sydney, Australia, but our team spans the globe. Since we don’t have a physical campus in Brazil, this role is fully remote—giving you the flexibility to work from wherever you thrive.

What You’d Be Doing In This Role

As Canva scales, change is part of our DNA. This role involves:

  • Strategy: Acting as the main leadership point for user and revenue growth in Brazil, coordinating local and global teams to create and execute a multi-year growth strategy, and owning KPIs such as MAUs and ARR.
  • Localization: Working with regional teams to optimize our product, content, pricing, and packaging to meet local market needs, considering cultural nuances across diverse audiences.
  • Leadership: Hiring, inspiring, and coaching the in-market team, ensuring high impact and performance management.
  • Budget: Collaborating with regional teams to shape marketing strategies and allocate budgets.
  • Sponsorship: Building relationships with enterprise, education, government, and partnership stakeholders.
  • Public Face: Representing Canva at press, PR events, and community engagements.

You're Probably a Match If

You excel in:

  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for growth across multiple sectors.
  • Experience in market growth, such as leading a regional team for a SaaS company or being a founder in a high-growth startup.
  • Proven leadership, with ability to inspire and coach teams, and high emotional intelligence.
  • Excellent communication skills in English, with the ability to influence stakeholders.
  • Analytical skills, focused on KPIs, with the ability to derive insights from data.
  • Product orientation, with experience localizing global products for specific markets.
  • Alignment with Canva’s mission and values, with strong references.
  • Public speaking experience and media presence skills.
  • Well-established network in government, corporate, media, or local talent sectors.

About The Team

Our international team is diverse and distributed, focusing on expanding Canva’s presence in key markets. As the Brazil Country Manager, you will lead strategic efforts to grow user base and revenue, coordinating cross-functional teams and leveraging deep market knowledge.

What’s In It For You

We aim for big goals and celebrate moments of success. Benefits include:

  • Equity packages
  • Inclusive parental leave
  • Annual wellbeing and social packages
  • Flexible leave options

Visit lifeatcanva.com for more info.

Other Important Details

We value experience, skills, and passion. Please share your pronouns and any accommodations needed during the interview. We welcome diverse backgrounds and skills. Interviews are conducted virtually.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1100+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We are hiring a Engineering Manager for Sustaining Engineering passionate about open source software, Linux and cloud computing. Come build a rewarding, meaningful career working with the best and brightest people in technology at Canonical, the growing international software company behind Ubuntu.
Sustaining Engineering is a business critical team that continuously improves various open source software by resolving software defects reported by customers. Software stack includes everything from the kernel all the way up to the user space applications and IaaS platforms. This position leads one of our regional teams and is one of several managers, who report directly to the global Director of Sustaining Engineering.
Our customers build large-scale mission critical infrastructure and application solutions on Ubuntu and open source from Canonical. While not actively developing products, Sustaining Engineering, as part of Support Engineering, solves problems for the customer and for the benefit of the wider Open Source community. This team is well staffed with experts in every time zone and, while the work can be challenging sometimes, the team is resourced to ensure a good work-life balance and ongoing development of each team member.
As an engineering manager in the Sustaining Engineering team, your primary responsibility is to the people you support: ensuring that they are growing as engineers, making valuable contributions, and generally having a great experience at Canonical. Technical leadership and a solid background in software development are a must, so that you are able to help your team members grow professionally. You will have the opportunity to influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.
Location: This is a globally remote role, unless specified otherwise.
The role entails

  • Manage and lead a distributed team of engineers
  • Hire, coach, mentor, provide feedback and career development guidance to your team
  • Manage & measure key performance indicators (KPIs), and training
  • Support timely delivery of bug fixes, patches, and other technical solutions to address business needs in a variety of technology fields, including but not limited to Ubuntu, OpenStack, Ceph, Kubernetes, Juju & MAAS
  • Demonstrate the very best of Canonical in customer interactions
  • Set and manage expectations with other engineering teams, senior management, and external stakeholders
  • Advocate and advance modern software development practices
  • Grow a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company value
  • Collaborate with other teams in the organisation
  • Work from home with global travel up to 10% for internal and external events
What we are looking for in you
  • Professional software delivery experience using C, C++, Go, Python, or similar
  • You are knowledgeable and passionate about software development
  • Leadership experience displaying ability to organise and prioritise complex problem resolution and bug fixes
  • Experience with version control systems such as git
  • Experience with debugging tools such as gdb, crash or other
  • Demonstrated strong commitment to testing methodologies and maintainable code quality
  • Excellent communication skills in the English language, both verbal and written
  • Experience with Linux, with a preference towards Ubuntu
  • Experience with Open Source and Open Source Business Models
  • People management experience in a support organisation is a strong plus
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Your Wellbeing Matters. Join a Company That Cares.

GET TO KNOW US

Wellhub (formerly Gympass*) is a corporate wellness platform that connects employees to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep, all included in one subscription designed to cost less than each individual partner. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in NYC, we have a growing global team in 11 countries. At Wellhub, you have the opportunity to build a career in a high-growth tech company that places wellbeing at the foundation of its culture, and contribute to making every company a wellness company.

Big news: Gympass is now Wellhub! We are thrilled to announce our rebranding as Wellhub, marking a significant milestone in our journey. This transformation reflects our evolution from a “pass for gyms” to a comprehensive employee wellbeing solution. With our refreshed identity, we are poised to embark on an exciting new chapter of growth and expansion. We are elevating our offerings, including a completely new app experience and an expanded network of wellbeing partners. Learn more about it here.

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Tax Planning Senior Manager to our Tax & Finance team in Brazil!

The Tax Planning Senior Manager is responsible for leading tax planning initiatives, managing special tax projects, and ensuring compliance with global and local tax regulations. This role requires expertise in corporate tax strategy, mergers and acquisitions (M&A), transfer pricing, and cross-border tax structuring. The Senior Manager will collaborate with internal stakeholders and external advisors to optimize the company’s tax position while mitigating risks. Additionally, this role plays a critical part in protecting the company’s business model by ensuring tax strategies align with operational and strategic goals and enhancing awareness of the business model across the organization.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Develop and implement tax-efficient strategies to support business growth and financial objectives.
  • Provide tax advice on corporate transactions, including M&A, restructurings, and investments.
  • Support cross-functional programs across the company to ensure tax efficiency.
  • Identify tax-saving opportunities and assess the impact of tax law changes.
  • Oversee tax-related projects, including new products and tax restructurings.
  • Ensure tax policies and strategies support integrity and sustainability of the business model.
  • Partner with Finance, Legal and leadership teams to align tax planning with overall corporate strategy, ensuring key stakeholders understand the tax impact on business operations.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life balance.

Who You Are

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Law, Taxation, or related field (Master’s or CPA preferred).
  • 5+ years of tax experience in a corporate or consulting environment.
  • Strong knowledge of international and domestic tax laws, transfer pricing, and M&A.
  • Experience with tax technology solutions and data analytics is a plus.
  • Excellent project management, analytical, and communication skills.

What We Offer You

We're a wellness company that is committed to the health and wellbeing of our employees. Our flexible program allows you to customize your benefits, according to your needs!

Our Benefits Include

  • WELLNESS: Health, dental, and life insurance.
  • FLEXIBLE WORK: At Wellhub, flexibility fosters a happier, healthier, and more productive work environment for everyone. As a Flexible First company, we offer two work model options: flexible hybrid and full remote, and make the office a place for collaboration, community, and team building. The model for this role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. We offer all employees a home office stipend and a monthly flexible work allowance to help cover the costs of working from home.
  • FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Wellhubbers and their leaders can make the best decisions for their scope. This includes flexibility to adjust their working hours based on their personal schedule, time zone, and business needs.
  • WELLHUB: We believe in our mission and encourage our employees and their families to take care of their wellbeing too. Access onsite gyms and fitness studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental health support, and more. You will receive the Gold plan at no cost, and other premium plans will be significantly discounted.
  • PAID TIME OFF: We know how important it is that our employees take time away from work to recharge. Vacations after 6 months and 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + extra day off for your birthday.
  • PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life and we want our employees to take the time to be present and enjoy their growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents and extended maternity leave.
  • CAREER GROWTH: Outstanding opportunities for personal and career growth. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do and invest deeply in employee development.
  • CULTURE: An exciting and supportive atmosphere with ambitious people from around the world! You’ll partner with global colleagues and share in the success of a high-growth technology company disrupting the health and wellness space. Na Laços Saúde, acreditamos que o cuidado deve ser um reflexo da individualidade de cada pessoa, promovendo a autonomia e a qualidade de vida dos nossos pacientes. Como parte do nosso compromisso com um modelo inovador de assistência, buscamos Médicos Geriatras apaixonados pela transformação do cuidado à saúde no ambiente domiciliar, seguindo os princípios do modelo Buurtzorg, que prioriza o autocuidado e a manutenção das funcionalidades das pessoas em suas próprias comunidades.

Sobre Nós:

Na Laços Saúde, a diversidade é o coração do nosso trabalho. Acreditamos que cuidar é um ato de amor e acolhimento, e isso se reflete em nossa equipe, que é composta por profissionais de diversas origens e experiências. O modelo Buurtzorg que adotamos é mais do que um método: é uma filosofia que prioriza o cuidado comunitário, respeitando a individualidade e as necessidades de cada pessoa. Se você é um fisioterapeuta que acredita na transformação do cuidado à saúde, venha fazer parte da nossa equipe e ajude a moldar o futuro da saúde no Brasil. Aqui, cada dia é uma nova oportunidade de fazer a diferença na vida das pessoas.

Tem Paixão pelo Cuidado? Então junte-se a nós!

A Laços Saúde está pronta para receber você!

Vamos juntos cuidar da saúde da comunidade!

Proporcionar atendimento de qualidade, acessível e humanizado através da telemedicina, promovendo o bem-estar mental e emocional dos pacientes. O médico geriatra deve atuar com empatia, responsabilidade e ética, garantindo diagnósticos e tratamentos assertivos, respeitando a individualidade de cada paciente e contribuindo para a melhoria de sua qualidade de vida. Join to apply for the Graduate Legal Counsel - Tech Sector role at Canonical

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are expanding our in-house legal team, creating an opportunity for an exceptional recent graduate as junior Legal Advisor or junior Legal Counsel. The successful candidate will be a rigorous and effective practitioner with a track record of academic achievement and social engagement. At Canonical they will have the opportunity to work on a variety of transactional matters in the technology and enterprise software realm, as well as the contracts that underpin global employment, contracting and partnerships. In this appointment we are more focused on ability than experience; the position is open to applicants with a relevant degree, but does not have a requirement for extensive work experience. The successful candidate will work closely with our in-house legal team and colleagues worldwide.
Candidates must be able to demonstrate good commercial judgment as well as being organized, efficient, and capable to provide high quality legal and commercial advice. We are looking for a rigorous work ethic, detailed analysis, conscientiousness, and the ambition to identify opportunities for improvement.
Location : This role is home based in Europe, the Middle East, Africa or the Americas, with the option of our London office.
The role entails

  • Report to our global general counsel
  • Draft, review, and negotiate commercial contracts with customers and vendors in many countries across the globe
  • Provide legal support to various internal clients across the company, including Canonical's sales organization
  • Interface with cross-functional teams to support company initiatives
  • Utilize Canonical's contract management system to ensure accurate data is maintained for signed contracts
  • Work with local counsel in many countries to seek and implement advice
What we are looking for in you
  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • A degree in law, JD or equivalent, and active license to practice law or current progress towards that
  • Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • Strong organizational and prioritization skills with the ability to work in a fast-paced, multi-cultural environment
  • Effective both independently and as part of a team
  • A passion for technology evidenced by personal initiatives and projects
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent drafting and presentation skills
  • Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation
  • Appreciative of diversity; polite and effective in a multicultural multinational organization
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Thoughtfulness and self-motivation
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long
Nice-to-have skills
  • Experience in commercial transactions, intellectual property, or corporate law
  • Leadership and the ability to influence others to embrace new ideas or practices
  • Understanding of the open source software community and values
  • Understanding of the technology industry - silicon, data centers, PCs, connected devices, and software
  • Experience working on in-house legal team and/or law firm
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.
