This role will initially be a temporary freelance position supporting the preparation phase for the FWWC2027, transitioning to a fixed-term contract position once the FIFA27 local subsidiary is established in Brazil.
THE POSITION
Under the responsibility of the Tournament Director and in collaboration with the FIFA Finance division, the Head of Finance will contribute to the development of the financial strategy, will oversee the financial operations of the new entity and will manage the dedicated finance team.
The finance department of the entities will include the following functions: Accounting, Controlling, Treasury, Tax, Insurance and Procurement.
Key Responsibilities
Initial Phase
  • Build and lead a Finance Team including Accounting, Controlling, and Procurement.
  • Establish financial functions, open bank accounts, and implement FIFA Financial tools.
  • Review and implement FIFA policies and procedures to ensure compliance and transparency.
  • Perform basic accounting and payroll tasks; develop initial budget forecasts.
  • Prepare financial reports as required by FIFA and entity management.
  • Support legal entity set-up and cooperation with third parties and authorities.
Planning & Operating Phase
  • Lead all finance functions (Accounting, Controlling, Procurement) for FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil.
  • Oversee tax, insurance, and financial compliance with IFRS and FIFA principles.
  • Act as a business partner to guide decision-making and manage financial risks.
  • Coordinate with FIFA on budgeting, consolidation, and reporting requirements.
  • Establish relations with senior management, external partners, and stakeholders.
  • Analyze cash flow, expenditures, and revenues; produce error-free accounting reports.
  • Oversee tax audits, tax returns, GST returns, and improve accounting processes.
  • Support FIFA in overall tournament financial planning.
  • Implement procurement processes; assist with insurance coverage implementation.
  • Manage, supervise, and motivate the Finance team; contribute to daily financial tasks as needed.
YOUR PROFILE
  • Higher business education, specialized in Finance or Accounting (university degree or equal education)
  • Minimum of 10 years’ experience in audit or finance at senior level including 5 years of proven experience in a managing financial function preferably in an event organisation (organising major sport events or other similar projects)
  • In-depth understanding of local GAAP
  • Experience in Insurance and Procurement matters
  • Previous experience within a finance position in Brazil is preferred.
  • Good computer knowledge (user), especially MS Excel and SAP
  • Excellent leadership and team-management skills
  • High ability of lateral thinking
  • Ability to take initiative and have a persistent focus on quality
  • Excellent analytical skills
  • Forward looking mind-set with strong results-orientation
  • Flexibility and open-mindedness
  • Ability to work under pressure and endurance
  • Very high sense of responsibility
  • Strong and transparent communication skills
  • Ability to engage with staff at all levels of the organisation and exercise sound judgement.
  • Reliability with a strong sense for cooperation/teamwork
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (oral and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (oral and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.
This role will be a temporary freelance position, before transitioning to a full-time fixed term contract role once a local FIFA subsidiary is established in Rio de Janeiro. Initially whilst working on a freelance basis, this role will allow full-time remote work but may require you to be based full-time (5 days per week) in the office once the subsidiary is established.

title: GERENTE SUB-REG ORIGINACAO & INSUMOS
description:
Você conhece a LDC? A LDC é uma das principais comercializadoras e processadoras global de produtos agrícolas, com um portfólio diversificado, que abrange toda a cadeia de valor, da originação à distribuição. Com atividades no centro da produção agrícola e de alimentos e guiados pelos nossos fortes valores, por um legado rico e uma visão clara, estamos comprometidos em trabalhar por um futuro seguro e sustentável. Ajudamos a alimentar e vestir cerca de 500 milhões de pessoas todos os anos, originando, processando e transportando aproximadamente 81 milhões de toneladas de produtos. Estruturada como uma organização matricial de 6 regiões geográficas e 10 plataformas, a LDC está ativa em mais de 100 países e emprega cerca de 18.000 pessoas em todo o mundo. Somos guiados por valores que norteiam todos os públicos em nosso trabalho. A ética e integridade fazem parte de todas as relações de negócio, assim como a humildade, comprometimento e diversidade.

Descrição da vaga

  • Conhecimento complexidade logística regional (movimento dos fretes, execuções logísticas, capacidades de embarque/descarga, modais logísticos);

  • Gestão de orçamento e recursos;
  • Marketing Estratégico;
  • Conhecimentos regulatórios e jurídicos inerentes às operações comerciais.

Qualificações

  • Formação superior em engenharia agronômica, administração, economia ou outras correlatas;
  • Sólida vivência com gestão de pessoas.

Informações adicionais

Diversidade, Inclusão e Equidade

A diversidade é parte do nosso DNA. A LDC busca sempre criar um ambiente de trabalho diversificado e inclusivo, onde todas as pessoas possam prosperar. Respeitamos e valorizamos talentos de todos os gêneros, idades, raças, etnias, sexualidades, religiões e deficiências. Diversidade é um de nossos valores! Essa oportunidade destina-se também às pessoas com deficiências (PcD).

Sustentabilidade

O valor sustentável está no centro de nosso propósito como empresa. Somos apaixonados pela criação de valor justo e sustentável, tanto para nossos negócios quanto para outros stakeholders da cadeia de valor: nosso pessoal, nossos parceiros comerciais, as comunidades e o meio ambiente ao nosso redor.

title: Senior Risk Manager (Argentina)
description:
Join to apply for the Senior Risk Manager (Argentina) role at Indero (formerly Innovaderm)

5 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Role Overview

The Senior Risk Manager plays a pivotal role in developing and executing risk-based monitoring strategies, ensuring data quality and integrity in clinical research projects. This position involves cross-functional collaboration to identify, assess, and mitigate risks throughout the clinical trial lifecycle, supporting the seamless implementation of Risk-Based Study Management (RBSM) principles.

Responsibilities

  1. Provide subject matter expertise for developing and updating the risk-based monitoring strategy tailored to project needs.
  2. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify and mitigate risks associated with complex indications.
  3. Draft initial risk assessments and support the finalization of Risk Assessment and Categorization Tools (RACT).
  4. Guide Project Managers (PMs) in transferring identified risks to the appropriate tracking systems and ensure ongoing reviews.
  5. Advise on developing functional plans to mitigate risks effectively.
  6. Utilize available tools to conduct remote data reviews and centralized statistical monitoring, identifying risks to data quality and integrity.
  7. Facilitate internal and sponsor reviews of findings, seeking cross-functional support for complex risks and mitigations.
  8. Deliver initial and ongoing training for study teams on risk assessment, centralized monitoring, and risk-based monitoring strategies.
  9. Mentor peers and train new team members on functional delivery, risk evaluation, and action implementation.
  10. Escalate risks or deliverables at risk to the PM, including scope changes.
  11. Provide strategic input on risk characterization and reporting to leadership.
  12. Take on additional responsibilities as required, ensuring qualifications and training align with assigned tasks.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in a field relevant to clinical research; Master’s degree or health data sciences degree preferred.
  • Expertise in Good Clinical Practice/ICH E6 (R3) Guidelines and other regulatory requirements.
  • Proficiency in Risk-Based Monitoring strategies, processes, and tools.

Technical Skills

  • Mastery of MS Excel (sorting, filtering, pivot tables).
  • Advanced skills in analytical data visualization tools.
  • Knowledge of Lean Six Sigma and web based RACT tools.

Core Competencies

  • Strong analytical and statistical understanding.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and leadership skills.
  • Ability to anticipate critical issues and develop proactive contingency plans.
  • Skilled in project workflows and cross-functional collaboration.
  • Training, mentoring, and organizational capabilities.

Experience

  • Minimum of 5 years in risk management within a clinical research setting.
  • Minimum 7 years of experience across clinical monitoring, data management, drug safety, medical monitoring, biometrics, or project management.

Attributes

  • Fluent in English (excellent oral and written).
  • Must be able to communicate clearly and effectively at all levels within the organization and with external customers.
  • Must be a fast learner and able to understand new concepts quickly.
  • Prioritization skills with the ability to plan, monitor, and manage workload fluidly in response to changing project demands.
  • Excellent understanding of project protocol, project documentation including centralized monitoring and risk-based monitoring.
  • Broad working knowledge of the roles, functions and process of conducting clinical trials.
  • Must be able to manage time effectively, working with multiple functions and requirements.
  • Must have been involved in the use of trial management or data management systems.

Good knowledge of good clinical practices, and applicable Health Canada and Food and Drug Administration (FDA) regulations/guidelines.

Additional Information

  • Seniority level: Not Applicable
  • Employment type: Full-time
  • Job function: Finance and Sales
  • Industries: Research Services

Join to apply for the Chair, Department of Psychiatry role at Lehigh Valley Health Network

Chair, LVHN Department of Psychiatry
Lehigh Valley Health Network (LVHN), proudly part of Jefferson Health, is seeking a proven and effective leader to spearhead our Department of Psychiatry as Chair. The Chair will support the Lehigh Valley Fleming Neuroscience Institute as part of the LVHN legacy services in addition to the Psychiatry & Human Behavior service line under Jefferson Health.

Position Overview
Chair, LVHN Department of Psychiatry
Lehigh Valley Health Network (LVHN), proudly part of Jefferson Health, is seeking a proven and effective leader to spearhead our Department of Psychiatry as Chair. The Chair will support the Lehigh Valley Fleming Neuroscience Institute as part of the LVHN legacy services in addition to the Psychiatry & Human Behavior service line under Jefferson Health.
The Department of Psychiatry at LVHN is one of four pillars of the Lehigh Valley Fleming Neuroscience Institute, the other pillars being the Department of Neurology, the Department of Neurosurgery, and the Fleming Memory Center. Under this Institute structure, these four key entities are devoted to the clinical, academic/research, and educational missions related to brain/nervous system and mental health in the region and beyond. The Lehigh Valley Fleming Neuroscience Institute is a system partner of the Vicky and Jack Farber Institute for Neuroscience of Thomas Jefferson University.
LVHN and our Department of Psychiatry are dedicated to providing a safe and comfortable place for our community to overcome life’s challenges. Our team of psychiatrists, psychologists, physician assistants, certified registered nurse practitioners, licensed clinical social workers, psychiatric nurses and occupational therapists work collaboratively to ensure the best outcomes for their patients.
In addition to our inpatient behavioral health services at Lehigh Valley Hospital (LVH)–Muhlenberg, LVH–Schuylkill and LVH–Pocono, we provide short-term services at LVH–Muhlenberg and LVH–Cedar Crest, which include individual, couples, family and group therapy. Our department also aids with medication management to children, adolescents and adults.

We provide a full continuum of care in behavioral health from emergency evaluation to intensive care, partial hospitalization, outpatient follow-up, homecare and skilled nursing facility consultation. We are growing the Department of Psychiatry which is comprised of more than 30 Psychiatrists and 120 mental health professionals in addition to our residency and fellowship programs.
Discover more about LVHN along with our mission and values on our about page or learn more about the LVHN Department of Psychiatry.

As Chair Of Psychiatry With LVHN, You Will
Oversee clinical operations of the Department of Psychiatry. Provide leadership and management oversight in areas of quality improvement, care management, clinical program development, business development, medical staff relationships and policies, education and research.

  • Essential functions include:
  • Appoint and supervise all Division Chiefs, the program director of the department's residency programs, and other physician leaders within the department.
  • Develop, implement and manage quality improvement and care management programs.
  • Oversee, manage and maintain the quality of all educational and research activities.
  • Appoint appropriate physician and non-physician leadership for the department's educational and research activities.
  • Work with other members of the administration on the development of clinical programs designed to meet the needs of the people served by the network.
  • Work collaboratively with the Network Office of Research and Innovation and LVHN’sInstitutional Review Board to ensure the research produced by department members meets the rigorous standards of human subject safety and academic excellence.
  • Oversee the business and financial implications of psychiatry program development.
  • Serve as a member of the Lehigh Valley Physician Group (LVPG) Board of Governors.
  • Serve as a member of the network’s Medical Executive Committee.
  • Maintain good relationships with network affiliated education organizations.
  • Collaborate with all clinical entity leaders to provide comprehensive psychiatric programs for our community.
  • Collaborate with colleagues across Jefferson Health and within the Behavioral Health service line to provide comprehensive care across our community.
Compensation and benefits for Chair, Department of Psychiatry with LVHN
We acknowledge the dedication of our colleagues and offer a benefits package that makes LVHN an even better place to work and grow your career. And now that we’re proudly part of Jefferson Health, we can offer current and future clinicians new educational and development opportunities at Thomas Jefferson University across our larger service area. We leverage its position as a world-class medical institution to recruit the best and brightest clinicians.
Our compensation/rewards package is highly competitive, and benchmark driven, including a significant opportunity for a performance-based incentive. As a large health network, we also offer a robust and comprehensive benefits package including health, vision, dental, short / long term disability, CME and retirement benefits, to name a few.
About The Lehigh Valley Area
The Lehigh Valley is one of the fastest-growing areas in the country, located in the heart of eastern Pennsylvania, 60 miles from Philadelphia and 80 miles from New York City. The area has outstanding public and private school systems, more than a half-dozen colleges and universities and an abundance of cultural and recreational year-round offerings. As a resident of the Lehigh Valley, you’ll experience the charming, close-knit community atmosphere while being just a short drive from the hustle and bustle of larger cities. Learn more about the Lehigh Valley by visiting our careers page.

  • PennsylvaniaMedical License

title: Legal & Compliance Manager
description:
Join Our Legal Team at Covetrus!

Are you a skilled legal professional looking to make an impact in an international environment? We’re seeking a talented individual to support Covetrus’ International Region in Brazil, working closely with the VP Legal International and Deputy General Counsel.

In this role, you’ll tackle a wide range of legal matters across all Brazilian entities within the group, crafting pragmatic solutions to complex challenges. You’ll collaborate cross-functionally with diverse teams across the globe, providing strategic legal guidance in a fast-paced and evolving industry. If you thrive in an international setting and enjoy working on diverse legal issues, we’d love to hear from you!

Fluency in English is essential for this role. To be considered, please submit your CV/Resume in English.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provide practical legal advice and support across a range of business functions in Brazil (in charge) and internationally and on ad hoc projects (as support)
  • Draft and negotiate commercial contracts, e.g. purchase, distribution and service agreements, IT contracts, Terms and Conditions, Data Privacy
  • Assist with all company matters, including commercial, competition and employment
  • Responsible for maintaining and updating the company's legal records and licenses with the relevant authorities
  • Work towards the creation and continuous improvement of contract templates and processes
  • Promote a culture of compliance and ethics within the team
  • Assist with the implementation of policies, procedures and best practices
  • Monitor and report on the latest legislative and judicial developments/changes in the country, inter alia, advising the Board of Directors on potential impacts and risks
  • Work cross-functionally with all internal stakeholders, including finance, HR, IT, distribution, regulatory, procurement teams and marketing
  • Develop and deliver training sessions for local teams on various legal topics
  • Effectively collaborate with external counsel when appropriate
  • Represent the company in court and local authorities

QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Law from Brazil, member of the Brazilian Bar Association, with excellent academic credentials. Postgraduate degree in Corporate Law or Compliance or similar qualification is an advantage
  • At least 8 years of substantial relevant experience with a top-tier law firm or in-house legal department, preferably in the healthcare, pharmaceutical or related sectors.
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese is required. Additional language skills are an advantage.
  • In-depth knowledge of Brazilian labor, commercial, competition and compliance legislation, with specific knowledge of the LGPD. Knowledge of regulations from Animal Health and Agricultural Regulatory Agencies (ANVISA, MAPA, SIPEAGRO, ADAB, etc.) is a plus.
  • Strong grounding in ethics and corporate governance, with the ability to advise on ethical business practices and corporate governance issues.
  • Experience in dealing with complex compliance issues, including antitrust and anti-corruption laws. Ability to conduct risk assessments and provide guidance on risk management, especially in areas unique to the Brazilian market.
  • Experience with Brazilian legal proceedings, including administrative and judicial proceedings, and the ability to represent the company before local authorities.
  • Excellent time management, communication, decision-making, presentation, interpersonal and organizational skills in an international environment.
  • Team-oriented, self-directed and hands-on, with a strong sense of responsibility and ownership and the ability to network effectively within the legal and regulatory community.
  • Experience working internationally and remotely in multiple locations, ideally within a matrix organization.
  • Ability to understand business issues, identify legal issues in commercial transactions and provide practical legal recommendations and business considerations.

Covetrus is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Join to apply for the MÉDICO NEUROLOGISTA - CER role at SPDM/PAIS - Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde .

A SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Realizar atividades na especialidade de neurologia, diagnosticar e prevenir patologias, indicar tratamentos e procedimentos relacionados ao cérebro, medula espinhal, nervos periféricos e músculos, visando acompanhamento e/ou reabilitação do paciente, conforme diretrizes da Instituição, Ministério da Saúde e Secretaria de Saúde.

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Medicina

description:

Software Engineering Manager - Sustaining Engineering

3 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Software Engineering Manager - Sustaining Engineering role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1100+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We are hiring a Engineering Manager for Sustaining Engineering passionate about open source software, Linux and cloud computing. Come build a rewarding, meaningful career working with the best and brightest people in technology at Canonical, the growing international software company behind Ubuntu.
Sustaining Engineering is a business critical team that continuously improves various open source software by resolving software defects reported by customers. Software stack includes everything from the kernel all the way up to the user space applications and IaaS platforms. This position leads one of our regional teams and is one of several managers, who report directly to the global Director of Sustaining Engineering.
Our customers build large-scale mission critical infrastructure and application solutions on Ubuntu and open source from Canonical. While not actively developing products, Sustaining Engineering, as part of Support Engineering, solves problems for the customer and for the benefit of the wider Open Source community. This team is well staffed with experts in every time zone and, while the work can be challenging sometimes, the team is resourced to ensure a good work-life balance and ongoing development of each team member.
As an engineering manager in the Sustaining Engineering team, your primary responsibility is to the people you support: ensuring that they are growing as engineers, making valuable contributions, and generally having a great experience at Canonical. Technical leadership and a solid background in software development are a must, so that you are able to help your team members grow professionally. You will have the opportunity to influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.
Location: This is a globally remote role, unless specified otherwise.
The role entails

  • Manage and lead a distributed team of engineers
  • Hire, coach, mentor, provide feedback and career development guidance to your team
  • Manage & measure key performance indicators (KPIs), and training
  • Support timely delivery of bug fixes, patches, and other technical solutions to address business needs in a variety of technology fields, including but not limited to Ubuntu, OpenStack, Ceph, Kubernetes, Juju & MAAS
  • Demonstrate the very best of Canonical in customer interactions
  • Set and manage expectations with other engineering teams, senior management, and external stakeholders
  • Advocate and advance modern software development practices
  • Grow a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company value
  • Collaborate with other teams in the organisation
  • Work from home with global travel up to 10% for internal and external events
What we are looking for in you
  • Professional software delivery experience using C, C++, Go, Python, or similar
  • You are knowledgeable and passionate about software development
  • Leadership experience displaying ability to organise and prioritise complex problem resolution and bug fixes
  • Experience with version control systems such as git
  • Experience with debugging tools such as gdb, crash or other
  • Demonstrated strong commitment to testing methodologies and maintainable code quality
  • Excellent communication skills in the English language, both verbal and written
  • Experience with Linux, with a preference towards Ubuntu
  • Experience with Open Source and Open Source Business Models
  • People management experience in a support organisation is a strong plus
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

A AVSI Brasil ( é uma organização brasileira, sem fins lucrativos, constituída em 2007, para contribuir na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas que vivem em situações de vulnerabilidade. É uma organização local vinculada ao contexto internacional, por meio da parceria com a Fundação AVSI, ONG de origem italiana que atua no Brasil desde os anos 80 e que estimulou a criação da AVSI Brasil. Sua missão é tornar as pessoas, em situações de vulnerabilidade ou emergência humanitária, protagonistas do próprio desenvolvimento, da sua família e comunidade, por meio de projetos sociais em diferentes áreas.

Compreende a prestação de serviços especializados voltado para qualquer ação que realize trabalho socioeducativo e pedagógico sobre a questão de eficiência energética, seja com cliente de baixa renda, residencial, comércio e serviço, unidade do poder público ou outros na área de abrangência das distribuidoras de energia do grupo Neoenergia.

Interlocução com os líderes locais para a apresentação, entrada e permanência das ações nas comunidades; Acompanhar a equipe subordinada em suas atividades; Fazer palestras educativas sobre Eficiência Energética; Supervisionar e monitorar as instalações físicas e condições para execuções dos serviços; Supervisionar e monitorar os materiais e equipamentos disponibilizados para execução das ações; Supervisionar e coordenar o trabalho das equipes diretamente subordinadas; Validar a localização e solicitar a ligação provisória de energia elétrica; Interlocução com secretarias de Educação e demais órgãos competentes; Identificar e sinalizar a necessidade de treinamentos específicos para as equipes; Identificar e sinalizar problemas na execução das atividades, propondo melhorias no processo.

PRINCIPAIS ATIVIDADES E RESPONSABILIDADES DO CARGO:

  • Guia e orientação da visita do público nos espaços “aulas de energia”;
  • Montagem e desmontagem das unidades móveis educativas;
  • Serviço de palestras educativas sobre uso eficiente e seguro da energia elétrica;
  • Serviços de reparo e manutenção nas UME e nos equipamentos dos acervos;
  • Operação dos equipamentos no processo;
  • Atendimento ao público, estudantes e professores;
  • Auxílio nas atividades de rotina do processo;
  • Apoio aos projetos educacionais: energia que transforma e festival tô ligado na energia;
  • Habilidade com o pacote Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint);
  • Apoio administrativo (pesquisas internet; organização e controle de material; alimentar planilhas).

title: Pleegzorgbegeleider Haaglanden
description:
Ben jij er graag voor pleegkinderen, ouder(s) en pleegouders, zodat kinderen kunnen opgroeien in een stabiele en fijne omgeving? Kom dan werken als pleegzorgbegeleider bij Timon in de regio Haaglanden.

Doortastend, geduldig en daadkrachtig

Een stabiele en veilige omgeving is niet altijd vanzelfsprekend. Daar weten we bij Timon alles van. Lukt het echt niet thuis, dan is een pleeggezin vaak een oplossing, voor korte of langere tijd. We proberen altijd om een kind terug te laten gaan naar de ouders, tenzij het niet anders kan. Als pleegzorgbegeleider bij Timon ondersteun je ouder(s), pleegouders en pleegkinderen bij de uitdagingen waarvoor zij staan. Elke situatie is anders. En het kan gaan om een vrijwillige plaatsing, voogdij of een ondertoezichtstelling (OTS). Dat vraagt van jou als pleegzorgbegeleider om geduld, sensitiviteit en daadkracht. Je kunt goed organiseren en houdt overzicht. En, als de situatie erom vraagt, overwicht.

Jouw werk doet ertoe

Als pleegzorgbegeleider coördineer je de pleegzorgplaatsing en alles wat daarbij komt kijken. Je begeleidt de samenwerking tussen ouder(s) en pleegouders. Daarbij staat het belang en de ontwikkeling van het kind altijd voorop. Je ondersteunt richting kind, pleegouders en ouder(s) in hun rol. Je monitort de samenwerking en signaleert. En biedt individuele ondersteuning en gezamenlijk ondersteuning in de samenwerking in het zorgteam. Samen zoek je naar oplossingen. Je signaleert spanningen en emoties. Hebt oog voor loyaliteit en hechting. En kijkt altijd naar het beste voor het kind. Met als doel: een fijne omgeving zodat het kind zich kan ontwikkelen. Kortom, jouw werk doet ertoe.

Dit ga je doen

  • Je ondersteunt het kind, de pleegouders en de ouders en bent de schakel tussen hen.
  • Je stelt samen doelen op, legt die vast in een plan en gaat daarmee aan de slag.
  • Je bent een klankbord voor pleegouders en biedt handvatten voor zorg en opvoeding.
  • Je houdt contact met instanties als zoals school, GGZ, Jeugdbescherming en CJG.
  • Je zorgt dat iedereen zich gehoord en gezien voelt
  • Je werkt zelfstandig en overlegt met collega’s en de gedragswetenschapper .

'Het mooist vind ik wanneer we samen met ouders en pleegouders een kind zien ontwikkelen.'

Nicole van Schaijk, pleegzorgbegeleider bij Timon. Lees het heleverhaal van Nicole .

Dit vragen we van je

  • Een relevant hbo-diploma (bijvoorbeeld Social Work of Pedagogiek).
  • Een geldige SKJ-registratie.
  • Rijbewijs B en een auto.
  • Goede mondelinge en schriftelijke communicatievaardigheden.
  • Een aantal jaar relevante werkervaring in de jeugd- of pleegzorg.

Dit bieden wij

Op basis van een 36-urige werkweek kun je rekenen op:

  • Een bruto maand salaris volgens de cao Jeugdzorg (schaal 9) van € 3. 191,69 tot € 4.929,28, afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring.
  • Een jaarcontract van 24 uur tot 36 uur per week. Functioneer je goed? Dan zetten we dit contract om in een vast dienstverband.
  • 25 vakantiedagen, 8% vakantiegeld en reiskostenvergoeding.
  • Een eindejaarsuitkering van 8,3% van je bruto jaarsalaris.
  • Een eigen coach die jou helpt met je persoonlijke doelstellingen en ontwikkeling.

Binnen Timon krijg je een uitgebreid inwerktraject waarin we je koppelen aan een buddy. Daarnaast volg je diverse trainingen en opleidingen gericht op jouw functie, zoals: Functiescholing pleegzorg, Contextuele hulpverlening en Traumasensitief werken.

Wij zijn Timon

Je christelijke geloof verbinden met je professionele inzet? Dat kan bij Timon! Bij ons ben je er voor kinderen, jongeren en ouders. En ons team is er voor jóu. Iedereen kan een beroep op ons doen, ongeacht achtergrond en levensovertuiging. Met ruim 800 bevlogen medewerkers werken we in een groot deel van Nederland. Timon innoveert en groeit. We denken in kansen en zetten graag een stapje extra.

Jij @ Timon?

Herken je jezelf in deze vacature en denk je dat je past bij onze organisatie? Solliciteer dan snel, de collega’s van Haaglanden gaan graag met je in gesprek.

Será responsável por desenvolver viagens de grande volume e eventos no exterior.

Durante um dia típico, você fará:

  • Supervisão de equipe: garantir o funcionamento eficiente da equipe com resolução eficaz de problemas.
  • Monitoramento de atividades diárias com distribuição equitativa de tarefas, acompanhando a produtividade e assegurando que os objetivos sejam cumpridos de forma eficaz.
  • Treinamento e desenvolvimento da equipe: Planejamento e execução de programas de treinamento para capacitar a equipe, assegurando que estejam bem preparados para lidar com diferentes situações, fornecedores e clientes.
  • Gestão de Parcerias Estratégicas: Negociar e gerenciar parcerias com instituições educacionais, agências de viagem e outros stakeholders para expandir a oferta de programas de intercâmbio.
  • Planejamento e Lançamento de Campanhas: Desenvolver a estratégia e executar campanhas junto ao marketing de promoção para os produtos de intercâmbio, visando aumentar a visibilidade e atratividade no mercado.
  • Gestão de Programas Existentes: Monitoramento e otimização contínua dos programas de intercâmbio existentes para garantir sua relevância e competitividade.
  • Análise de desempenho e elaboração de relatórios: avaliar a performance da equipe e dos produtos do portfólio, gerando relatórios detalhados com insights e sugestões para aumentar resultados da U.N.
  • Monitoramento de indicadores de desempenho: Acompanhamento regular de KPIs (Key Performance Indicators).
  • Relacionamento interdepartamental: Colaboração com outras áreas da empresa, como vendas, operações e marketing, para garantir uma experiência integrada e consistente para os clientes.
  • Implementação de tecnologias e ferramentas: Avaliação de cenário e adoção de novas tecnologias e ferramentas para melhorar a eficiência e a qualidade do serviço da unidade de negócio.
  • Pesquisa de Mercado: Manter-se atualizado sobre as tendências do mercado de intercâmbio e as necessidades dos clientes, com plano de ação para adaptar os serviços da empresa de acordo.
  • Projetos: avaliar, implementar e gerenciar projetos para garantir a melhoria contínua dos processos e produtos, ajustando estratégias conforme necessário para atingimento de metas.

Requisitos e habilidades para a função:

  • Experiência com viagens/eventos internacionais de grande volume.
  • Ensino superior e MBA completo nas áreas.
  • Ter estudado em universidades no exterior (Cursos ou formação).
  • Visão estratégica.
  • Gestão de produto.
  • Análise de mercado e pesquisa.
  • Gestão de portfólio.
  • Estratégia de precificação.
  • Desenvolvimento de parcerias estratégicas.
  • Gestão de projetos, inovação e melhoria contínua.
  • Experiência com venda de intercâmbio.
  • Proativo e dinâmico.
  • Inglês avançado.

O que oferecemos:

  • Vale Refeição/Alimentação;
  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico;
  • Licença Maternidade diferenciada;
  • Subsídio para acompanhamento com psicólogo;
  • Desconto na compra de intercâmbio;
  • Benefício da Allya – Descontos em parceiros de diversos segmentos, tais como: saúde, bem-estar, farmácias, academias, cursos, cinema, serviços, lazer, restaurantes, e-commerces, lojas, entre outros;

Demais informações:

Nossa gente aqui na Egali sonha alto ! Somos centenas de apaixonados pelo que fazemos. A nossa cultura é focada em construir um ambiente inclusivo e colaborativo, onde as pessoas possam ser o melhor delas mesmas! Gente é o nosso maior ativo, afinal sabemos que investir no potencial de nossos colaboradores é trazer ainda mais qualidade ao nosso negócio. Por isso, oferecemos uma trilha de encarreiramento sólida, com possibilidade de desenvolvimento de carreira internacional. Na Egali 100% dos nossos executivos são formados aqui , e todos os colaboradores possuem a possibilidade de desenvolvimento através de uma trilha incrível de construção de carreira, com módulos no Brasil e no exterior. Diante disso, estamos sempre em busca de talentos diversos , dispostos a conectar pessoas aos seus sonhos, com a missão de promover o intercâmbio de forma responsável.

Job description

AQUI SUA CARREIRA COMEÇA GRANDE.

VENHA SER UMA PESSOA COORDENADOR CURSO I NA ESTÁCIO.

Temos um projeto grandioso que requer um time com disposição para pensar de forma original e disruptiva, com o objetivo de resolver as grandes questões de hoje na educação: acesso, tecnologia, customização e o sucesso dos nossos alunos.

Somos uma companhia cheia de energia, que já nasceu gigante e com resultados extraordinários.

Venha fazer parte desse time!

VENHA TRANSFORMAR VIDAS. INCLUSIVE A SUA.


Main responsibilities

Os principais desafios como PESSOA COORDENADOR CURSO I são:

  • Ajudar os nossos alunos em suas metas, por meio de uma boa relação, fazendo-os perceber que devem procurá-lo sempre que for preciso para resolver problemas referentes ao seu dia a dia na faculdade, como escolha de disciplinas, problemas ou queixas com os docentes, ou demais pedidos e demandas que venham a surgir, colaborando para que nossos alunos possam atingir seus objetivos educacionais e de carreira;

  • Cumprir os prazos estabelecidos no calendário acadêmico;
  • Contribuir para a realização de ações preparatórias para o ENADE;
  • Registrar, por meio do sistema de informações acadêmicas (SIA), os resultados das atividades acadêmicas dos alunos;
  • Assegurar o cumprimento dos prazos dos processos acadêmicos;
  • Trabalhar em equipe com os órgãos de assessoramento para elaborar ou atualizar o Projeto Pedagógico do Curso;
  • Receber as comissões do MEC para o processo de autorização, reconhecimento e renovações;
  • Realizar atividades acadêmicas complementares para os alunos.

Requirements and skills

Buscamos profissionais com:

  • Titulação Mínima: MESTRE;
  • Formação Superior em GRADUAÇÃO EM ENGENHARIA E/OU ÁREAS CORRELATAS;
  • Desejável experiência como docente e em cargo de gestão;
  • Capacidade de comunicação e relacionamento com o aluno;
  • Atualização e domínio de conhecimentos teóricos e práticos para a função pretendida.

Additional information

Local de Trabalho: Estácio Fortaleza Centro.

Horário de Jornada: 20h semanais.

Na ESTÁCIO você vai encontrar:

  • Bolsas de estudo de até 100% para colaboradores, dependentes legais e agregados;
  • Assistência médica com subsídio integral para o colaborador e parcial para sua família;

  • Universidade Corporativa no nosso portal exclusivo;
  • Oportunidades de crescimento , hoje mais de 60% das vagas são fechadas com processo de seleção interno.

Trabalho remoto (home office) estendido para os pais recém-chegados da licença maternidade e paternidade por até 3 meses.

Executar outras tarefas correlatas, quando necessário;

Venha fazer parte da nossa equipe!

  • Boa comunicação

  • Assistência Médica
  • Assistência Odontológica
  • Convênio de compras Asun
  • Convênio com Sesc
  • Refeição no local

Nossa história

Nossa história nasceu do sonho de uma grande mulher empreendedora, a espanhola Asunción Romacho. Em 1960, dona "Asun", como era chamada carinhosamente, chegou ao Brasil. Trouxe junto no navio os três filhos, a sogra e a experiência de sete anos como dona de uma ferragem na cidade espanhola de Guadix, na Andaluzia.

No ano de 1963, seu marido Ernesto instalou um pequeno armazém que ficava junto à casa da família, no bairro Cavalhada, onde todos trabalharam juntos durante anos.

Em 1975, a família deixou Porto Alegre rumo a Quintão, com muitos desafios, pois naquela época não havia luz elétrica na cidade. A iluminação ficava por conta de lampiões, carne, manteiga e perecíveis eram mantidos em isopores. Não tinha horário, "Eu começava às vezes às 7h e só saía meia-noite. Ficava até quando tinha cliente" – lembra a matriarca, em bom espanhol, que os mais de 40 anos no Brasil não a fizeram perder. Asunción passou 10 anos em Quintão, até voltar para Porto Alegre, em 1985. No retorno à Capital, a fundadora não abriu mão de seu lugar, de pé, atrás de uma caixa da loja.

A rede cresceu e a matriarca de uma família supermercadista tem hoje seu apelido estampado na fachada de 42 lojas, agora presentes não só em praias gaúchas mas também em Porto Alegre, Região Metropolitana de Porto Alegre e Serra Gaúcha.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We want to transform the world of software operations by enabling true model-driven operations via next-generation infrastructure-as-code. This will allow companies to run very efficient bare-metal operations for high-performance computing, private cloud, data lakes, AI/ML, and analytics. We need to invent some new technology, and we need to build some new products; we are therefore looking for someone who can lead and inspire a regional software engineering team to fulfill this initiative.
The Solutions Engineering team works in close collaboration with our managed infrastructure operations team, which runs many private OpenStack clouds and Kubernetes clusters for customers around the world. This enables us to improve our infra-as-code products based on our own real experience, mirroring that of our users and customers. We work in Python, creating open-source automation capabilities that simplify operations for anybody, anywhere, who is building on Ubuntu.
Most of the team's work involves pure Python software development focused on enabling true DevOps workflows. We strive for high quality in both design, documentation, tests, and performance as we enhance operations code packages and Ubuntu itself in order to ensure our platform is the easiest, most robust, and best performing for driving your infrastructure.
As an Engineering Manager, your primary responsibility is to the people you lead and support: ensuring that they are growing as engineers, doing valuable work, and finding satisfaction in their career at Canonical. We need someone who can display technical leadership by leveraging a solid background in software development so that they're able to challenge and grow their team members. You will have the opportunity to influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on direction and execution.
What you will do

  • Lead and develop a team of Python engineers working remotely in global locations
  • Hiring, coaching, mentoring, feedback, and hands-on career development
  • Demonstrate sound engineering principles by directly contributing code yourself
  • Plan and manage progress on agreed goals and projects
  • Set and manage expectations with other engineering and operations teams
  • Coordinate with management and internal and external stakeholders or customers
  • Advocate for modern, agile software development practices
  • Help develop and evangelize great engineering and organizational practices
  • Grow a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company values
  • Be an active part of the leadership team and collaborate with other leaders in the organisation
  • Travel globally up to 10% of time for internal and external events
Who you are
  • You love developing and growing people and have a track record of doing it
  • You are knowledgeable and passionate about agile software development
  • You love leading, coaching, and mentoring software developers - especially Python ones
  • You are knowledgeable in cloud computing concepts & technologies
  • You are comfortable administrating Linux servers, including their storage and networking
  • You have hands-on experience with software automation
  • You are organized and want your team to deliver high-quality software in a timely manner
  • You are a lifelong learner
Bonus points for
  • You have graduated with a university degree in Computer Science or related software engineering field
  • Having a thorough understanding of modern infrastructure, including OpenStack or Kubernetes
  • Having experience in operations as well as software development
  • Being familiar with the challenges of large-scale, multi-cloud operations
  • Go expertise
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Description

Willis Towers Watson (WTW) is seeking ambitious, analytical underwriting talent with 5-10 years of experience in the insurance industry with experience in builders’ risk and property underwriting. This is a high-profile client facing role working directly with WTW CRB NA to develop new and existing partnerships in line with its strategic growth initiatives. The successful candidate will work in a highly collaborative Verita (MGU) team environment.

Note: Employment-based non-immigrant visa sponsorship and/or assistance is not offered for this specific job opportunity.

The Role

  • Work with WTW’s broking team(s), Verita executives, actuaries, and cat modelers to analyze Verita’s insurance risks on a portfolio level to obtain capacity in the form of delegated authority, reinsurance structures and/or other innovative solutions.
  • Negotiate and place Reinsurance Treaties and/or FAC placements utilizing markets from London, the US, Bermuda and around the world.
  • Coordinate and attend underwriting and claim audits with Verita’s capacity markets on a regular basis.
  • Ensure that company, market and client related documentation is issued (internally and externally) accurately and on time.
  • Comply with external regulatory and internal statutory policies, procedures and regulations.
  • Coordinate internal resources, such as analytics, contracts and client services to provide solutions to client(s).
  • Meet with senior management both internally and externally to present materials.
  • The candidate must have experience in Builder’s Risk, General Liability and Property
    • Candidates with significant experience/relationships in one of these areas will be considered and expected to develop the expertise in the other areas.
  • Conduct comprehensive market analysis to identify trends, opportunities, and potential risks to Verita’s portfolio.
  • Engage with capacity providers and reinsurance markets to negotiate terms, pricing, and coverage to secure optimal outcomes for Verita.
  • Stay abreast of industry developments, regulatory changes, and emerging risks that may impact reinsurance strategies.
  • Assist in the training and development of graduate hires.
  • Other duties and responsibilities as assigned.
  • Good understanding of pricing components and rating methodologies
  • Uses all appropriate underwriting tools, disciplines and knowledge of strategies to ensure underwriting guidelines are followed
  • Exhibits strong underwriting skills through strategic, thorough account reviews and file documentation
  • Adheres to guidelines and underwriting discipline to minimize exposure and appropriately price risk.
  • Complete understanding and ability to use sophisticated pricing models across various structures, guaranteed cost, captives, SIR’s, deductibles, etc.

Qualifications

The Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree (B. A.) from a four-year College or university.
  • 8+ years of work experience, preferably in Property and Casualty insurance, reinsurance or related non-life insurance consulting.
  • Understanding of Managing General Underwriter program life cycles and placements.
  • Strong negotiation skills
  • Ability to multi-task priorities in a fast-paced, high intensity environment.
  • Experience in giving presentations to prospects, capacity partners and internal groups.
  • Computer skills, including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook.
  • Effective analysis, problem solving and communication skills.
  • Strong knowledge of property insurance policies and regulations.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Attention to detail and accuracy in assessments.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Very strong technical and leadership qualities
  • Well established in the marketplace and has excellent relationships with brokers and agents on both regional and national level
  • Well versed and experienced in working, producing and underwriting all sizes of accounts with large brokerage houses, agents and specialty retailers.
  • Established underwriting, quoting and binding track record of profitable business.

This position will remain posted for a minimum of three business days from the date posted or until a sufficient/appropriate candidate slate has been identified.

Compensation and Benefits
Base salary range and benefits information for this position are being included in accordance with requirements of various state/local pay transparency legislation. Please note that salaries may vary for different individuals in the same role based on several factors, including but not limited to location of the role, individual competencies, education/professional certifications, qualifications/experience, performance in the role and potential for revenue generation (Producer roles only).

Compensation
The base salary compensation range being offered for this role is $150,000 - $250,000 USD per year. This role is also eligible for an annual short-term incentive bonus.
Company Benefits
WTW provides a competitive benefit package which includes the following (eligibility requirements apply):

  • Health and Welfare Benefits: Medical (including prescription coverage), Dental, Vision, Health Savings Account, Commuter Account, Health Care and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts, Group Accident, Group Critical Illness, Life Insurance, AD&D, Group Legal, Identify Theft Protection, Wellbeing Program and Work/Life Resources (including Employee Assistance Program)
  • Leave Benefits: Paid Holidays, Annual Paid Time Off (includes paid state/local paid leave where required), Short-Term Disability, Long-Term Disability, Other Leaves (e.g., Bereavement, FMLA, ADA, Jury Duty, Military Leave, and Parental and Adoption Leave),Paid Time Off
  • Retirement Benefits: Contributory Pension Plan and Savings Plan (401k). All Level 38 and more senior roles may also be eligible for non-qualified Deferred Compensation and Deferred Savings Plans.

At WTW, we trust you to know your work and the people, tools and environment you need to be successful. The majority of our colleagues work in a ”hybrid” style, with a mix of remote, in-person and in-office interactions dependent on the needs of the team, role and clients. Our flexibility is rooted in trust and “hybrid” is not a one-size-fits-all solution.

title: Director, Ecosystem Engineering
description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

ENGINEERING - GAMES

What We Do

Unreal projects have been leading the pack of real-time entertainment with our constantly growing team of engineering experts. We’re always improving on the tools and technology that empower content developers worldwide.

What You'll Do

Join us in shaping the future of Fortnite — one of the world’s most influential interactive platforms. We’re looking for an experienced engineering leader to drive the development of foundational systems that support the Fortnite experience at scale — including player onboarding, progression, identity, lobbies, and purchasing. These systems form the connective tissue of the Fortnite ecosystem, powering player interaction, progression, and seamless transitions between experiences. This role is central to our goal of delivering consistent, high-quality user experiences across internal and third-party content — while enabling scale, flexibility, and innovation for the entire platform.

In this role, you will

  • Set the technical vision and architecture for Fortnite’s ecosystem systems, driving scalability, consistency, and platform evolution.
  • Lead development of features that span all Fortnite content, ensuring unified experiences and reliable scale across modes
  • Partner with internal teams (e.g., Battle Royale, LEGO Fortnite, new IPs) to ensure systems align with desired flows and player-facing requirements.
  • Collaborate with third-party developers to enable flexible, performant integration with Fortnite's shared systems.
  • Grow and lead a high-performing team, fostering a culture of innovation, inclusion, and engineering excellence.
  • Drive platform evolution while balancing stability, performance, and flexibility for diverse use cases.
  • Drive innovation and creative problem solving in areas that do not have an internal precedent

What we're looking for

  • Proven experience architecting and building user-facing systems in a live services or platform environment (e.g., menus, accounts, progression, commerce).
  • Strong understanding of scalable backend and client-service patterns, ideally in cross-platform or online service contexts.
  • Comfortable navigating complex user flows and dependencies across multiple teams and surfaces.
  • Strong leadership and communication skills with a track record of cross-functional collaboration.
  • Passion for building intuitive, reliable systems that support a wide range of player and developer needs.

EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

We pay 100% for benefits for both employees (EEs) and dependents (deps). Our current benefits package includes coverage for medical, dental, and life insurance. We also offer supplemental benefits including daily meal vouchers, and commuter benefits for onsite employees.

ABOUT US

Epic Games spans across 25 countries with 46 studios and 4,500+ employees globally. For over 25 years, we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.

Like what you hear? Come be a part of something Epic!

Este é um Banco de Talentos de Professores para a Escola Eleva São Paulo. A Escola Eleva é uma das escolas Inspired no Brasil. Aqui nós temos vocação para ensinar e paixão por aprender. Nossa missão é formar uma nova geração de líderes capazes de fazer a diferença em suas vidas e contribuir para um mundo melhor. Para isso, contamos com um time de profissionais inquietos, com brilho nos olhos e movidos por entusiasmo. Pessoas que superam desafios diariamente, com otimismo e acreditando no legado que estamos construindo.

Se juntando a nós como professor(a), sua missão principal será lecionar para nossos alunos, estimulando o desenvolvimento deles com cuidado, responsabilidade e entusiasmo!

O que você fará:

  • Adquirir conhecimento sobre os programas curriculares utilizados nas séries em que leciona;
  • Trabalhar colaborativamente com outros professores e lideranças da matéria e do segmento, buscando alinhamento e consistência;

  • Ministrar aulas da matéria alinhadas com a BNCC e o Material Didático selecionado pela escola (físico ou digital);
  • Utilizar práticas variadas de ensino/aprendizagem, incluindo metodologias ativas, ensino responsivo, avaliação para o aprendizado (Assessment for Learning) e métodos investigativos;
  • Utilizar de forma consistente tecnologias para enriquecer e melhorar o aprendizado;
  • Supervisionar alunos em espaços escolares;
  • Substituir professores no mesmo segmento quando solicitado;
  • Mediar relacionamento entre crianças, famílias e escola;
  • Preparar avaliações e comunicar os resultados;
  • Tabular e analisar dados pedagógicos com o intuito de ajustar ensino e melhorar o aprendizado;
  • Formatar e alimentar com dados nossa plataforma de acompanhamento de avaliações (iSams) em preparação para relatórios para famílias;
  • Participar de reuniões pedagógicas (incluindo COC) e eventos realizados na escola;
  • Garantir a segurança física e emocional dos alunos, e zelar pelo seu crescimento sócio-emocional (safeguarding).

Por mais que nos esforcemos para incluir todas as principais responsabilidades e atribuições desta posição, pode ser que nem toda atividade pertinente à função tenha sido identificada. Dessa forma, a lista acima não é restritiva e pode ser estendida ou alterada para incluir outras tarefas que se aplicam ao cargo.

O que você precisa ter:

  • Diploma de licenciatura na matéria da sua área ou de Pedagogia ou Normal se tiver interesse em posição de Regente para Infantil ou Fundamental 1.

Nossos professores devem ser capazes de/devem ter:

  • Paixão pela profissão;
  • Estar sempre em busca de melhorias;
  • Atitude positiva frente a mudanças;
  • Compreensão profunda da matéria lecionada;
  • Estabelecer expectativas claras e esticar metas;
  • Excelente planejamento de aulas e domínio de sala;
  • Habilidade de julgar a efetividade do aprendizado;
  • Comprometimento com o desenvolvimento dos alunos, avaliando os resultados e fornecendo feedback para melhorar seu desempenho;
  • Preocupação e atenção genuína pelos níveis mais altos de bem-estar dos alunos.

Será um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Experiência em escolas bilíngues ou internacionais;
  • Inglês intermediário ou avançado.

O Inspired se compromete em salvaguardar e promover o bem-estar das crianças e jovens e, se você se juntar ao nosso time, esperaremos o mesmo de você, assim como que se comprometa a realizar os treinamentos de safeguarding que consideramos pertinentes à sua função. A proteção do bem-estar dos nossos alunos é de responsabilidade de todos os colaboradores e os mesmos devem se comportar de maneira a refletir os princípios e valores da organização. Qualquer candidato pode ser submetido aos procedimentos apropriados de verificação.

title: Principal Database Administrator
description:
Kaizen Gaming, the team powering Betano, is one of the biggest GameTech companies in the world, operating in 19 markets.We always aim to leverage cutting-edge technology, providing the best experience to our millions of customers who trust us for their entertainment.

We are a diverse team of more than 2.700 Kaizeners, from 40+ nationalities spreading across 3 continents. We are an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of race, gender, religion, sexual orientation,or age.

Our #oneteam is proud to be among the Best Workplaces in Europe and certified Great Place to Work across our offices. Here, there’ll be no average day for you. Ready to Press Play on Potential?

Let’s start with the role

We are looking for an experienced and highly skilled Principal Database Administrator to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for maintaining, troubleshooting, and optimizing our MS SQL Server environments, with a strong focus on availability, security, and performance. You will play a key role in ensuring the continuous operation of our databases, particularly in complex, high-availability scenarios such as Availability Groups. In addition, you will bring your knowledge of alternative database engines like MongoDB and CockroachDB, as well as your expertise in cloud-based database administration.

As a Principal Database Administrator, you will:

  • Provide comprehensive day-to-day support, monitoring, troubleshooting, and administration for multiple MS SQL databases, with a particular focus on high-availability configurations like Availability Groups.
  • Diagnose and resolve complex performance and availability issues, with in-depth root cause analysis to prevent future occurrences.
  • Oversee database maintenance processes, including performance tuning , index management, and job automation, ensuring optimal operation.
  • Develop and enforce policies for backup and recovery , ensuring database resilience and disaster recovery readiness.
  • Apply security patches , conduct version upgrades, and enforce strict compliance with database security best practices.
  • Handle support calls and resolve technical issues swiftly, including response to security incidents and operational challenges.
  • Leverage expertise in alternative database engines like MongoDB and CockroachDB to contribute to cross-functional database projects.
  • Manage and optimize cloud-based database environments , ensuring scalability, performance, and reliability in cloud infrastructure.

What You’ll Bring:

  • Solidhands-on experience in MS SQL Server Database Administration in production environments.
  • Extensive experience with MS SQL Server database features, including Jobs Scheduling, Monitoring, Patching, Backup/Recovery, Replication, Availability Groups , and Always On configurations.
  • Proven expertise in diagnosing and resolving performance bottlenecks and availability issues .
  • Solid understanding of alternative database engines like PostgreSQL , MongoDB and CockroachDB , with practical experience in their administration and troubleshooting.
  • Proficiency in cloud database administration , with experience in cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
  • Fluency in English , both written and verbal, with excellent communication skills.
  • Strong teamwork, analytical thinking, and problem-solving abilities, alongside a proactive approach to continuous learning.
  • A commitment to mentoring and supporting junior team members.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Join to apply for the Machine Learning Engineer role at Techunting

We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer who dares to work with cutting-edge technology! It involves inspiring yourself with state-of-the-art research papers to help with the Machine Learning model design, implementation, training, and deployment. You will be responsible for applying the best MLOps practices and principles to the whole modeling workflow. It will require you to gain great insight into the problems, conceive how data can be exploited, and how new concepts can be created. This role enables you to apply novel ideas that can change the world, while learning a lot at the same time!

Main responsibilities and duties:

  1. Stay up-to-date with the latest advancements in machine learning by exploring and drawing insights from state-of-the-art research papers. Leverage this knowledge to design and develop innovative machine learning models tailored to our specific needs.
  2. Translate conceptual models into practical implementations, utilizing programming languages and machine learning frameworks. Train and fine-tune models to achieve optimal performance and accuracy.
  3. Drive the deployment process of machine learning models into production environments. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure smooth integration and scalability of the models.
  4. Apply the best MLOps (Machine Learning Operations) practices and principles throughout the entire modeling workflow. Streamline processes for efficient development, testing, and deployment of machine learning solutions.
  5. Dive deep into problem domains to gain a comprehensive understanding of challenges and opportunities. Analyze and preprocess data to extract valuable insights for model improvement.
  6. Propose and experiment with novel ideas and approaches to tackle complex problems. Explore creative ways to leverage data and develop new concepts that could potentially revolutionize the field.
  7. Collaborate with a team of skilled professionals, including data scientists, engineers, and domain experts. Foster a collaborative environment that encourages knowledge sharing and continuous learning.

Qualifications and Skills:

  1. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software or Electrical Engineering, or comparable professional experience in Machine Learning related areas.
  2. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  3. Experience working with native ML orchestration systems such as Kubeflow, Step Functions, MLflow, Airflow, and TFX.
  4. Experience in technologies like Spark, Kafka, Spark streaming, Flink, etc.
  5. Expertise in MLOps and model integration into larger-scale applications.
  6. Experience with implementing and scaling feature stores across organizations.
  7. Strong programming skills in Python and experience with popular machine learning libraries/frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch).
  8. Expertise in using Docker and Kubernetes.
  9. Strong problem-solving skills and ability to analyze and translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  10. Ability to read, interpret, and apply research papers in machine learning. A strong grasp of foundational machine learning concepts is essential.
  11. Knowledge of agile methodologies and ability to work in a fast-paced and evolving environment. Willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies and methodologies.

description:
Responsibilities
The Global Communications team at TikTok is responsible for all external communications related to the company. We're currently looking for a dynamic senior communications leader to join our fast-paced Global Communications team. As Head of Communications for Latin America, you will be responsible for providing ongoing counsel and partnership to the company's senior leaders across the region, while leading, inspiring and motivating a highly-engaged team.
We're looking for a dynamic leader with strong experience working in the technology industry. At TikTok, our leaders are also doers and you have proven experience conceptualizing, planning, and executing projects that have meaningful business impact. You're able to effectively manage through complex decisions and challenges, using sound judgment and expertise to mitigate risks and ensure the best outcomes. You are familiar with the media, regulatory and policy, as well as competitive landscape across the region and, as such, are able to effectively develop strategies to manage issues and mitigate risk, while ensuring balance between consumer and creative campaigns and reactive response efforts. As a strategic leader, you will work closely with other teams across the Global Brand & Comms department, including Marketing and CSR, as well as with our cross-functional partners — Product, Legal and Public Policy —to create cohesive and compelling communication strategies.
Ideal candidates are resilient, entrepreneurial-minded leaders who work well in an ever-evolving environment. You have strong media relationships. You collaborate with ease across teams and are able to weigh big picture objectives with immediate business needs. You're good at connecting the dots and you thrive in an entrepreneurial environment. And you lead with a compassionate, people-first mindset. This role reports to the Head of Global Corporate Communications.
Responsibilities:
- Advance the team's business objectives and enhance and protect corporate reputation in support of building our brand.
- Develop regional communication strategies that provide clear direction for the company's key initiatives.
- Build strong creative consumer campaigns, in partnership with Marketing, that help grow brand affinity.
- Create and lead strategies to effectively identify and mitigate early-stage crises while also effectively managing other potential risks to the company.
- Identify strategic priorities across the region aligned with cross-functional partners and mapped to overall business objectives.
- Work closely with teams, such as Public Policy and CSR, to develop and implement strategic communications plans that amplify how TikTok is enabling progress for businesses and communities.
- Lead and develop a high-performing team, while fostering a culture of excellence, accountability, and continuous development.
Qualifications
Minimum Qualifications:
- Extensive communications experience and a deep knowledge of consumer, business, and trade/vertical media in the region.
- Able to diplomatically handle change and exhibit sound judgment.
- Demonstrated experience in influencing stakeholders, resolving complex problems and ensuring collaboration within teams and across cross-functional disciplines.
- Proven ability to mentor and inspire high-performing teams across multiple geographies in region.
- Excellent strategic, analytical, and verbal communication skills.
- Previous experience working for a global company is strongly preferred.
- Must be fluent in English & Portuguese. Given the regional LATAM scope, Spanish would be a plus.
About ByteDance Brazil
ByteDance is a global incubator of platforms at the cutting edge of commerce, content, entertainment, and enterprise services - over 2.5 billion people interact with ByteDance products, including TikTok.

Why Join Us
Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.
Diversity & Inclusion
TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.

This person will own the strategic end-to-end enablement plan and calendar, to design, deliver and track enablement programs to accelerate talent development across products, industry or segment knowledge, and role-based competencies, that lead to better customer conversations and revenue growth.

title: Senior Product Manager, Amazon Payments
description:
Are you looking for a new challenge in a fast-paced, innovative company? Come make history in Amazon’s Brazil team! We are looking for a business savvy Sr. Product Manager to drive our payments initiatives in Brazil and create access to affordable payment methods. You will own the vision and roadmap to scale our digital payment products and work with global teams to support launches and management of new products.

The right candidate possesses a strong product/program management background, a deep understanding of BR Payments and financial/credit products competitive landscape, and demonstrated experience leading large projects. You will be responsible for product roadmap and development life-cycle, from working backwards from our Customers to define the vision for what is required to make the product launch and program successful in Brazil. You must be able to thrive and succeed in an entrepreneurial environment and not be hindered by ambiguity or competing priorities to scale a business in a new geography. This means you are not only able to own high-level strategic initiatives, but also roll up your sleeves, dig in and get the job done.

Key job responsibilities:

  1. Partner with key local and global stakeholders to work on ongoing and upcoming initiatives;
  2. Prioritize requirements, manage prioritization and trade-offs, and integration roadmap that efficiently meets the needs of various businesses in Brazil;

  4. Create go-to-market plan for the program and new features: gather business requirements, build and deliver against the roadmap, and create & monitor meaningful KPIs;
  5. Lead external partner relations: manage partner performance and customer experience, set objectives and success criteria, and drive towards operational excellence;
  6. Drive product awareness and adoption: identify marketing opportunities and support the delivery of effective marketing campaigns with internal and external partners;
  7. Lead the day-to-day operations: assess and manage risks, monitor and report on progress with actionable insights, anticipate and resolve bottlenecks, and provide escalation management.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

- 5+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience with end-to-end product delivery
- Experience with feature delivery and trade-offs of a product
- Experience as a product manager or owner
- Experience owning technology products

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience in influencing senior leadership through data-driven insights
- Experience working across functional teams and senior stakeholders
- Master's degree or equivalent
